jobs.title: Software Developer – Cloud Solutions
jobs.excerpt: About PulseLearningEstablished in 1999, PulseLearning is a world-class, award-winning provider of learning solutions supporting clients globally across all sectors.
jobs.description:
About PulseLearning

Established in 1999, PulseLearning is a world-class, award-winning provider of learning solutions supporting clients globally across all sectors.

We operate across the United States, United Kingdom, EMEA, Ireland, Canada, and Australia, delivering innovative, people-focused learning solutions that drive real impact.

Our team works collaboratively to design and develop learning experiences that inspire behavioral change and measurable results. At PulseLearning, we value creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Role Overview

The Software Developer will be part of a team designing, building, and maintaining modern, cloud-based software solutions in collaboration with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts. The successful candidate will bring strong software engineering fundamentals, hands-on cloud experience, and a builder's mindset to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable systems.

Remote Work Term position, 3–9 months (duration set by client requirements)

Full-time (40 hrs/week) and part-time (20 hrs/week) positions available ·

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to a team that develops or enhances, tests, and deploys scalable, secure, and cost-effective software solutions using cloud-native architectures and microservices
  • Contribute to a team that develops software using one or more modern programming languages such as Java, Python, TypeScript, Go, C#, C++, or Rust
  • Contribute to a team that designs and consume RESTful APIs and integration frameworks to enhance system interoperability
  • Contribute to a team that deploys and operate workloads on major cloud platforms, applying cloud services for compute, storage, databases, networking, serverless, and containers
  • Contribute to a team that defines and manages infrastructure as code and automated deployment pipelines (CI/CD)
  • Apply engineering best practices, including automation, unit and integration testing, code reviews, secure coding, and technical documentation
  • Work with both relational (SQL) and NoSQL database technologies, selecting the right data store for each workload
  • Leverage AI agents, generative AI, and AI-enabled developer tools to improve development productivity and code quality
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues, contributing to operational excellence and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Contribute to a team that manages multiple development activities concurrently while meeting project timelines and quality standards
  • Work effectively with remote and globally distributed teams across multiple time zones
  • Be current with cloud technologies, architectural patterns, AI-assisted development practices, and emerging industry trends

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional (non-internship) software development experience
  • 2+ years of experience with design or architecture of new and existing systems, including design patterns, reliability, and scaling
  • Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Java, Python, TypeScript, Go, C#, C++, or Rust)
  • Solid computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design principles
  • Hands-on experience building and operating solutions on a major public cloud platform; deep familiarity with AWS services and architecture best practices is strongly preferred
  • Experience with distributed systems, microservices, serverless architectures, and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform) and CI/CD tooling
  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL database systems
  • Understanding of security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, and secure API design
  • Experience using AI agents or AI-enabled tools within software development workflows
  • Experience delivering complex software systems successfully to customers
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly in English
  • Experience working with remote and geographically dispersed teams across multiple time zones
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, Solutions Architect, or DevOps Engineer) are considered an advantage or
  • Experience in machine learning, data engineering, building AI-enabled applications is desirable
  • Work flexible, Central time business hours

Open to all remote work locations in Canada, USA, and Ireland.

PulseLearning is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in any stage of the selection process. Please contact and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Salary: $40-$85 per hour

jobs.description:
Position Overview

Blue Acorn iCi is seeking an EDS Front End Developer to build, optimize, and maintain high-performance web experiences using Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS). This role focuses on modern, lightweight front-end development aligned to EDS best practices, emphasizing speed, scalability, accessibility, and content authoring efficiency.

You will collaborate closely with architects, UX designers, content teams, and engineering partners to deliver composable, edge-optimized digital experiences. The ideal candidate has strong front-end development expertise, experience with Adobe Edge Delivery Services, and a passion for building scalable, high-performing digital experiences.

Location: Remote - United States

Key Responsibilities

Edge Delivery & Front-End Development

  • Develop and maintain front-end components using Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS).
  • Implement content blocks, templates, and patterns aligned to EDS architecture.
  • Build responsive, high-performance web experiences using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Optimize sites for Core Web Vitals, performance, and SEO.
  • Lead the hands-on execution of the expanded migration proof of concept (POC).
  • Implement representative customer journeys using Adobe Edge Delivery Services.
  • Validate migration assumptions through practical implementation.
  • Document technical observations, challenges, and recommendations.
  • Support estimation activities by providing implementation-level insights.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to establish reusable migration patterns and technical standards.

Integration & Collaboration

  • Integrate front-end experiences with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and other Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.
  • Partner with UX/UI designers to translate designs into scalable front-end implementations.
  • Collaborate with architects and backend teams on composable and headless architectures.

Quality, Accessibility & Best Practices

  • Ensure compliance with WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following front-end best practices.
  • Perform code reviews and support delivery quality standards.

Delivery & Support

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Support testing, bug fixes, and production deployments.
  • Contribute to internal documentation and reusable component libraries.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS).
  • Advanced proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience with modern front-end tooling and workflows.
  • Solid understanding of performance optimization and edge-based delivery.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including authoring concepts and headless or hybrid implementations.

Professional Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating across cross-functional engineering, architecture, UX, and product teams.
  • Ability to follow architectural guidance and delivery standards.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and quality-focused mindset.

Platform Experience

Candidates should have experience with the following platforms and technologies:

  • Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS)
  • Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
  • Adobe Experience Cloud
  • HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+)
  • Core Web Vitals and SEO optimization
  • Git-based development workflows
  • Composable and headless architectures

Preferred Qualifications

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Git-based workflows.
  • Knowledge of SEO best practices and Core Web Vitals.
  • Exposure to headless or composable architectures.
  • Experience working on enterprise-scale Adobe implementations.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience delivering enterprise-scale Adobe Experience Cloud implementations.
  • Experience building composable, edge-optimized digital experiences.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $150,000–$180,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

About Blue Acorn iCi

Blue Acorn iCi, a business unit of Infosys Nova Holdings, LLC, is a digital experience partner helping global brands design, build, and optimize the future of customer engagement. We blend data, design, and technology to deliver connected commerce and content solutions that drive measurable results.

Specializing in the Adobe Experience Cloud, we provide end-to-end services across commerce, content, analytics, and customer insights. Backed by Infosys, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

Our teams work at the intersection of strategy and execution—solving complex challenges for industry leaders in healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and beyond. From large-scale digital transformation programs to platform implementations and ongoing optimization, we bring deep expertise and a collaborative mindset to every engagement.

Why Join Us?

Blue Acorn iCi is a place for curious thinkers, smart builders, and digital pioneers. We’re more than a consultancy—we’re a team of innovators helping the world’s top brands shape the future of digital.

Here, you won’t just contribute to a project—you’ll drive meaningful outcomes, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and grow your skills in a high-impact, high-growth environment. We believe great work starts with great people, and we’re committed to creating a culture where talent thrives, ideas spark change, and results speak for themselves.

If you’re ready to push boundaries, deliver real value, and help shape the next generation of digital experiences—this is your place.

Infosys Nova Holdings, LLC does not provide immigration or visa sponsorship for this position (including H4 EAD, H‑1B, OPT, CPT, TN, O‑1, E‑3, or J‑1 visas).***

Full Time, Non-Temporary Employees enjoy a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, life insurance, disability, paid time off, 401(k), and more!

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Building What Manufacturing Does Next

Are you a manufacturing technology executive who thrives on running a live product roadmap with one hand and inventing the next generation of shop floor AI with the other? Have you led teams that ship reliable software today while placing the bets that define tomorrow?

Redzone is seeking a VP of Innovation to own both our Integration Platform and Analytics product roadmap, and to lead Horizon 3 innovation for the Connected Workforce Platform as we scale globally across thousands of always-on manufacturing environments.

Who We Are: Empowering Frontline Workers to Win the Day

Manufacturing has been transformed by technology everywhere except where it matters most: the people running the lines. Redzone changes that.

We power communication, decision-making, and continuous improvement for frontline teams through:

  • Real-time collaboration across operations, maintenance, and quality
  • Intelligent software that anticipates issues, surfaces knowledge, and initiates action
  • Proven coaching that drives sustained behavior change on the shop floor

Our impact is measurable and repeatable:

  • 26% productivity uplift in just 90 days
  • 81% employee engagement
  • 35% reduction in frontline turnover

Today, more than 500,000 workers across 1,600+ factories on 6 continents rely on Redzone every shift. Backed by QAD, we are scaling with purpose and discipline.

The Opportunity: Own the Roadmap, Own What's Next

This is a dual mandate. You will own the product roadmap for Redzone's Integration Platform and Redzone Analytics, ensuring both continue to deliver reliable, scalable value to customers every shift.

At the same time, you will lead Horizon 3: Redzone's innovation engine for the ideas that don't exist yet. We expect 3-5 significant spikes per year. Most will fail fast and we will learn form. The ones that don't, your team will help scale into the core product with speed and discipline.

What You Will Drive: Roadmap Execution and Frontier Innovation

  • Own Redzone’s Integration Platform and Analytics Roadmap: Set priorities, sequence delivery, and ensure both products keep earning customer trust every release.
  • Run Horizon 3 as a Portfolio, Not a Pet Project: Manage 3-5 spikes a year like an investment portfolio, kill the losers quickly, and double down on what works.
  • Pioneer Visual and Physical AI on the Shop Floor: Build and prove AI that sees production efficiency, quality loss, changeover, downtime, and co-bot collaboration in real time.
  • Convert Spikes Into Scaled Products: Build the handoff discipline that takes a winning Horizon 3 bet and gets it into the core roadmap fast.
  • Lead Engineering Talent: Build and run teams that can ship a roadmap and run an innovation lab at the same time, without either one starving the other.

Who You Are: A Manufacturing Innovation Executive

  • 15+ years of IT/OT innovation experience in manufacturing, with a track record of shipping technology that changed how plants run
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the industry's most common ERPs, including QAD, SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics, and Infor
  • Experience across MES, WMS, and connected worker platforms, and how they integrate with each other on the plant floor
  • Proven experience leading both product and engineering teams, not just one or the other
  • Direct experience building or deploying computer vision or physical AI in industrial or production environments
  • Working knowledge of predictive maintenance and machine health approaches, including sensor data, IoT, and failure prediction models
  • Familiarity with world models, digital twins, or simulation approaches applied to operational or industrial systems
  • Comfortable running an innovation portfolio: setting hypotheses, killing bets quickly, and scaling the ones that prove out
  • Executive presence to operate in Horizon 3 ambiguity in the morning and defend Horizon 1 roadmap commitments in the afternoon
  • A pragmatic, no-drama operator who gets things done
  • Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
  • Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
  • Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
  • An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.

If you're ready to own the roadmap and build what manufacturing does next, let's talk. Apply now and help shape the future of manufacturing.

About QAD:

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

ORS are seeking a Structural Design Engineer to join our growing engineering team, delivering innovative structural solutions across complex projects in sectors including life sciences, semiconductor, industrial and commercial developments.

You will be responsible for the structural analysis and design of steel, concrete and other structural systems, working closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver safe, efficient and high-quality engineering solutions.   • Prepare structural calculations, design reports and technical specifications in accordance with relevant design standards and Eurocodes.
  • Produce and review structural designs using Robot Structural Analysis, Tekla Structural Designer, IDEA StatiCa and other engineering software.
  • Coordinate designs with BIM models using Navisworks and BIM360/Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
  • Work closely with BIM Technicians, Architects, MEP Engineers and project teams to ensure coordinated design delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with BIM Execution Plans, document control procedures and company quality standards.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

This role is on the Intercept team, which is part of Stripe's broader collection of public goods initiatives, including Frontier.

Respiratory viruses kill 1 million people a year, cost us $600B annually, disrupt everyday life, and periodically threaten civilization. Recent breakthroughs may make it possible to develop and deploy broad-spectrum preventatives and air cleaning technologies that defend against common respiratory infections. Intercept is a $500M philanthropic initiative that aims to radically reduce the burden of respiratory infections, and eventually eliminate them altogether. Learn more about Intercept via our launch post and our website.

What you’ll do

Intercept is looking for an exceptional scientist to join our team. We’re working to bring into existence a portfolio of broad-spectrum preventatives needed to radically reduce the burden of respiratory viruses. Our goal is to advance 2+ products that meet our target product profile through Phase 2. We make both grants and investments, using the most capital-efficient tool to advance our target product profile.

This role will focus on conducting research, managing projects, and supporting diligence across our grant and equity pipelines. This work requires shaping and building out our internal points-of-view across a wide range of modalities that are relevant to respiratory viruses, which include innate immunity, adaptive immunity, direct-acting antivirals, host-directed therapeutics, and physical formulation barriers for the upper respiratory tract. The role will generate high-quality theses to guide our approach to grant and equity investments as well as engage with a wide range of scientific experts, investors, funders, and other key stakeholders in the ecosystem to make sure Intercept is funding the best high-conviction ideas, concepts, and platforms.

We need someone who can (1) evaluate the quality and value of the science for impact vs probability of success, and (2) zoom out to synthesize what that means for our capital deployment plan and long-term goals. A successful candidate will be action-oriented and comfortable working independently (vs. waiting to be told what to do) and a great communicator who can translate complex science for diverse audiences.

Intercept is a small team; you'll work with the entire team, under Intercept’s Head of Science, many partners, and wear many hats. You'll own specific outcomes end-to-end and have a chance to contribute to BSP strategy over time.

Responsibilities

  • Develop theses on technological approaches to inform capital deployment. Generate high-quality research outputs to inform investment theses. Support the development of internal points of view for the most promising approaches that have the potential to meet our TPP. Experience with thinking through high-value experiments, technical data scrutiny, and triaging a wide funnel of ideas into the highest quality theses will be essential.
  • Identify scientific gaps and promising-but-underexplored ideas. Accelerate progress by identifying the questions that would most accelerate progress if answered. Hunt for the promising ideas that aren’t yet being fully explored.
  • Support diligence of grants and investments. Help review and triage inbound submissions received through our published RFP, identifying the most relevant projects and ideas that could result in the optimal broad-spectrum preventative. Help update our RFP material and/or launch specialized calls based on the current state of the field/portfolio.
  • Diligence pipeline opportunities. Support early and deep / technical diligence of our grant and equity pipeline: evaluating science quality, development plans, team, and fit against our TPP.
  • Engage a network of experts and primary literature to keep our strategy current. Engage networks (researchers, investors, founders, funders, etc.) to track research priorities, forecast trends, and identify cutting edge areas of science that Intercept should pursue.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Must have a PhD and/or MD in immunology and/or infectious disease with 3+ years of post-grad work experience (post-doc, academia, biotech, pharma, VC, or consulting)
  • Demonstrated capacity to explore and evaluate a broad range of scientific topics and experience with scientific curation (e.g., oversight of a research portfolio, grant making experience, investment experience, etc.)
  • Experience with the grant process, either success with receiving grant funding or awarding grants
  • Familiar with early-stage product development, ideally with some experience / contribution
  • Experience with project management from launch to completion / project quarterback with a high openness to getting hands dirty
  • Extremely self-directed, diligent, very fast learner, excellent communicator, very action oriented (vs talking about things)
  • Compelled by our mission to greatly reduce the burden of and risks from respiratory viruses

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with capital allocation, either with grants and/or investments
  • Experience with portfolio management, including portfolio construction and post-award management
  • Direct product development experience (optimally with candidate nomination, CMC, IND-enabling studies, and Ph I trial launch)

jobs.excerpt: We're transforming the grocery industryAt Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together.
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, and Targeting: converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.

We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist II to lead the algorithmic direction of these systems. This is a role for someone who thinks in terms of control theory, constrained optimization, and auction economics, and who can translate those frameworks into production code that makes millions of decisions per day. You will formulate problems from first principles, shape the technical roadmap, and own systems end-to-end from mathematical design through production deployment through impact measurement.

About the Job

  • Design and evolve real-time bid optimization systems that translate advertiser goals (target ROAS, budget constraints) into optimal auction bids under uncertainty. Formulate the bidding problem as constrained optimization and build the feedback mechanisms that keep bids aligned with realized outcomes.
  • Build intelligent budget pacing algorithms that distribute spend across time and auction opportunities. The core challenge: allocating a finite daily budget across stochastic demand while maximizing total value, subject to advertiser constraints and time-varying conversion dynamics.
  • Develop the analytical frameworks that connect bidding, pacing, and budgeting into a coherent optimization objective.
  • Shape auction mechanics including reserve pricing, multi-slot allocation, and bid-to-price mapping. Reason about mechanism design tradeoffs between advertiser outcomes, platform revenue, and marketplace efficiency.
  • Own the full research-to-production loop: diagnose system behavior from large-scale data, formulate hypotheses, design experiments, ship production code, and measure impact. Write technical strategy documents that set the algorithmic direction for the team.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate degree (Masters or PhD) in operations research, applied mathematics, control systems, computational economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 8+ years of experience building and deploying optimization or control systems in production environments (not just research prototypes).
  • Strong foundation in at least two of: feedback control theory (PID, MPC), convex and stochastic optimization, auction theory and mechanism design, dynamic programming.
  • Proficiency in one of the following languages: Go, Java, C++ for production systems and Python for data analysis and offline pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate mathematical formulations into production code that runs at scale (millions of decisions per day, sub-100ms latency constraints).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with real-time bidding systems, ad auction optimization, or computational advertising at scale.
  • Background in budget-constrained allocation methods. Experience with adaptive control or model-predictive control in production systems.
  • Familiarity with causal inference and experimental design for evaluating algorithmic changes in marketplace settings.
  • Track record of shaping technical strategy and driving cross-functional alignment between engineering, product, and data science.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Go-to-Market (GTM) Planning Strategy and Operations team works at the intersection of corporate planning, GTM Strategy, Product, GTM and Regional Strategy and Operations with responsibility for ensuring that we land the Stripe annual rhythm in a smooth and timely manner. This entails three main pillars:

• Building and landing foundations (tooling, process, and strategic changes) for next cycle • Ensuring budgets, territories, targets, comp plans, reporting, and enablement are delivered to GTM in a timely manner • Effectively managing in-year Account, Territory, Quota, and Adjustments

Within this organization, the Central Policy and Operations team owns the processes, systems, and automation that power territory management, account placement, segmentation, and business adjustments at scale—processing over 10,000 account movements per month and operating critical workflows that serve the entire GTM organization at scale.

What you’ll do

We're seeking an experienced systems practitioner to own the end-to-end processes, Mechanization and Automation pillar for Central Operations end-to-end. In this role, you'll be the person who wakes up every day focused on ensuring our support tooling has a clear roadmap, our processes are documented and AI-enabled, and our operational systems are built to scale without adding headcount.

You'll take ownership of how we design, build, and evolve the systems that underpin Stripe's territory, segmentation, quota, and adjustment infrastructure. This means moving beyond maintaining what exists today—you'll architect what comes next. You'll drive the transition from legacy tooling toward Stripe-native solutions, reduce contractor dependency through intelligent automation, and ensure every process is auditable, documented, and delegatable.

This is a role for someone who understands the difference between automating a broken process and redesigning it before automation—and has the experience to know which one to do when. Additionally, being able to work cross-functionally at 500-foot collaboration and working at 20,000 feet as needed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the process and tooling roadmap for Central Policy and Operations independently, setting short-to-medium-term strategic direction and aligning investment to areas of greatest need
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives across GTM, Finance Systems, and Data Engineering to align territory, quota, and adjustment data for AI enablement
  • Architect the path to transition off external tools toward Stripe-native tooling—building the business case, influencing resource allocation, and measuring ROI
  • Design and implement automation for Account Team assignments, User Segmentation updates, and Manager and Approval workflows in Salesforce to reduce manual intervention and contractor dependency
  • Build audit frameworks, compliance metrics, and governance processes for scaled systems (Territory Assignments, Quota, Workflows, Adjustment Approvals)
  • Establish documentation, process architecture, and AI-ready task design that enables leadership visibility, vendor onboarding, and repeatable delegation
  • Anticipate system integration risks and resolve them before they become escalations—including cross-system data movement between Salesforce, territory engines, and reporting infrastructure

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10 or more years of experience in business operations, systems development, technical program management, or a related discipline with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity
  • Proven track record of owning and delivering end-to-end systems or tooling programs in a cross-functional environment—from business case through implementation and ongoing optimization
  • Strong SQL proficiency and experience with data architecture, pipeline design, or systems integration work
  • Experience leading process redesign and automation initiatives that delivered measurable operational efficiency or cost reduction
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, build investment cases, and drive decisions across functions without direct authority
  • Effective communicator who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences and leadership, and translate business requirements into system specifications

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Anaplan, Salesforce, Approval Workflows, or Process design and administration, configuration, or development (flows, automation, data management)
  • Familiarity with territory management, sales operations planning cycles, or GTM systems at scale
  • Background in designing processes for AI enablement—structured documentation, task decomposition, and governance frameworks
  • Experience managing vendor relationships or coordinating with external implementation partners

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

While accepting payments on the internet has gotten easier over the past several years due in large part to the advent of modern payments APIs, the internet infrastructure for routing these same payments (to suppliers, sellers, partners, service providers, recipients) is stuck in the stone age.

Connect is Stripe's leading product for marketplaces, on-demand services, ecommerce site builders, invoicing platforms, professional SaaS products, fundraising platforms, rental management platforms, and more. By utilizing the power of Connect, users in each of these categories can link multiple parties for the exchange of goods or services. These users rely on Connect for the crucial function of reliably routing payments between these parties.

By powering fast, flexible, compliant, and cost-efficient routing of payments on the internet, Connect not only spurs the creation of innovative business models but it also enables organizations (whether they are businesses, nonprofits, or governmental agencies) to channel previously offline payments to the internet.

What you'll do

As a Product Lead on the Connect team at Stripe, you will devise strategy, develop product requirements, and oversee execution for some of the highest-impact initiatives that serve modern marketplaces and software platforms.

At Stripe, Product Managers help build innovative payments products for our customers. Product development is an extremely collaborative effort between engineering, design, analytics, and customer-facing teams. You'd be joining a team of experienced Product Managers who have a track record of successfully building large-scale business and consumer products that collectively impact millions of users around the world.

On a day-to-day basis you would spend your time split between external meetings with customers and internal discussions with your engineering, marketing, analytics, and sales counterparts, as well as with your direct reports, coaching, mentoring, and hiring. This role will provide the opportunity to develop the strategy for one of Stripe's core products and get feedback on your plans directly from Stripe's leadership team.

  • Define and drive the product roadmap for the Connect product, including the accounts and transaction APIs

  • Persistence and a whatever-it-takes approach to ensure that your product is successful

Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What we are building

The Quality & Compliance team at Domino is…

  • Building the assurance layer that lets the world's most regulated organizations put Domino at the center of their AI work. Our customers include global pharmaceutical companies, major financial institutions, and government agencies, organizations that cannot adopt a platform they can't evidence and defend to their own auditors.
  • Running a genuinely multi-framework program under one roof: SOC 2, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and CMMC. That combination means the work spans information security, quality management, and federal compliance.
  • Small, senior, and deliberately non-bureaucratic. We would rather have a small set of controls people actually follow than a large set nobody reads. Every SOP and policy we publish has to be clear enough to be used, not just clear enough to pass.
  • A team that sits directly in the revenue path. When an enterprise prospect sends a 400-question security questionnaire or a regulated customer asks how we manage change control, we are the answer, and how fast and how credibly we answer changes deal outcomes.
  • At an inflection point. We're moving from standing programs up to running them well and at scale, which means investing in tooling, reusable answer libraries, and a reliable operating rhythm instead of heroics.

What your impact will be

In your first year, you will:

  • First 90 days: You'll take over inbound security and quality questionnaires, learn our answer library and response tooling, and start returning routine questionnaires independently. You'll pick up the master audit and compliance activities schedule and begin giving the team real lead time on what's coming.
  • By six months: You'll own day-to-day QMS operations, new-hire team and training assignments, training content, and records for change orders, suppliers, and computer systems, with data accurate enough that we can report on it any day of the week, not just before an audit. GRC program status will be visible in Jira and Confluence without anyone assembling it by hand.
  • By twelve months: You'll be a trusted reviewer of our control statements across SOC 2, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and CMMC, catching drift between what a control claims and what our evidence actually shows before an auditor does. Our SOPs and policies will be current and readable because you've worked through them. Questionnaire turnaround will be measurably faster, with a larger share answered from the library instead of from scratch.

What we look for in this role

  • 2–5 years in GRC, compliance operations, quality assurance, or audit support, in a role where you did the hands-on work yourself.
  • Direct experience responding to security or quality questionnaires at volume, and comfort owning the shared tooling and answer library behind those responses.
  • Hands-on involvement in at least one audit or certification cycle end to end, SOC 2, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, CMMC, or a comparable framework, including evidence collection and findings follow-up.
  • Experience as the day-to-day administrator or power user of a compliance system of record (eQMS, GRC platform, or equivalent), with real accountability for data accuracy.
  • Strong technical writing and editing. You can turn a vague requirement into a clear, correct SOP, and a hard customer question into a precise answer.
  • Fluency in Jira and Confluence, and the discipline to keep them current without being reminded.
  • Real fluency with agentic AI tooling and frameworks, you've built custom skills, agents, or prompt-driven workflows to take repetitive work off your own plate, and you know where model output has to be human-verified.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and calendar discipline. Other people's deadlines depend on your tracking, and you treat that as a commitment.
  • Sound judgment about the limits of your own knowledge, you know when to answer, when to pull in an SME, and when to escalate. You never invent an answer to a customer-facing security question.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to working across Security, Engineering, Legal, People, and Sales.
  • Nice to have: experience in a regulated life-sciences, medical device, or pharmaceutical environment, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, computer system validation, or supplier qualification.

What we value

  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
  • We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work
  • We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything
  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company
  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply

We believe in a world where homes are owned by regular people, not corporations. We are growing fast and we are AI First. Our 200+ Belongers are strong, curious, and extremely ambitious.

The Role

This is a builder role with direct P&L impact. You will own and scale the homeowner supply growth engine (across acquisition, onboarding, activation, and retention). You’ll be the GM of your own system, driving strategy and execution for a full-stack, AI-first funnel. You’ll ship fast, measure everything, and bring a growth obsession that matches our ambition.
You’ll work at the intersection of product, data science, design, marketing, and AI infrastructure. Your mission is simple: generate high-quality supply faster and more cost-effectively every month.

You'll be building an AI-native homeowner acquisition funnel.

  • Conversational intake flows powered by LLMs that qualify, capture, and convert leads in real-time.
  • Personalized onboarding experiences that adapt dynamically based on user attributes, preferences, and model predictions.
  • Automated pricing, trust-building, and documentation flows that reduce friction and compress time-to-value.
  • Predictive scoring and routing systems to prioritize the right leads, with the right incentives, at the right moment.

Your Mandate

  • Own strategy and execution for Belong’s homeowner funnel, from first click to full activation.
  • Identify bottlenecks and explode them with product.
  • Partner with leaders to deeply link paid acquisition with in-product performance, and ensure sales and operations can deliver on the promise of Belong.
  • Define success metrics, instrument everything, and build dashboards that replace guesswork with precision.
  • Write crisp PRDs, wireframe smart workflows, and ship frequently.
  • Operate as both a strategic thinker and a tactical executor, you will lead and build.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in product management with ownership over growth funnels, ideally in a B2C or marketplace company.
  • You’ve driven CAC down, LTV up, and activation time down with product, not just marketing.
  • You’ve shipped AI-powered product features and understand LLMs, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
  • You’ve built experiments with rigor and made hard calls with imperfect data.
  • You understand user psychology and can design onboarding flows that convert skeptics into champions.
  • You communicate clearly, lead cross-functional pods, and get things shipped.
  • You play to win.

What Success Looks Like In Year 1

  • Homeowner acquisition costs are down, speed to activation is up, and conversion is accelerating.
  • AI is integrated across the funnel, delivering measurable improvements in cost, quality, and experience.
  • Experimentation velocity is high, insights are trustworthy, and every major decision has a clear metric trail.
  • The growth engine is humming, and you’re in the driver’s seat.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of product management experience, preferably in consumer marketplaces or high-growth startups
  • Demonstrated success driving growth initiatives in customer acquisition and retention
  • Experience working across the AARRR funnel (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, Revenue)
  • Strong understanding of UX principles and ability to turn concepts into high-fidelity wireframes and designs.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
  • Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and statistical methods
  • Experience integrating or working with AI technologies to enhance product capabilities
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and a focus on delivering value quickly
  • And you're pithy.

Who You Are

You don’t want to maintain someone else’s system, you want to build your own. You’re competitive. You run toward outcomes, not away from problems. You are customer-obsessed but ruthless about the business. You think in feedback loops. You crave autonomy and accountability. You’ve been underestimated before, and you’re not done proving people wrong.
You want to build a lasting product, and you know growth is where the game is won or lost.

jobs.description:
Outbound Sales Closer – High-Ticket Health & Wellness $50K Base + Uncapped Commission

$75K–$95K+ OTE (Top Reps Earn More) Remote (US-Based, Must Work EST Hours)

CJ Physical Therapy & Pilates | Portsmouth, NH

The short version: You'll work 80-100 outbound touches a day (call/text/email/video) against a list of warm-to-cold leads — people who raised their hand at some point but haven't booked yet — and convert them into Discovery Visits that actually show up. No cold-call prospecting from scratch. This is a full sales cycle: build rapport fast, handle real objections (cost, skepticism, "let me think about it"), and lead people to a decision.

This isn't a customer service job. And it's not a call center.

You're the first conversation someone has after deciding they're tired of living with pain.

They've probably tried physical therapy before. Maybe injections. Maybe they've been told surgery is their next step. Your job is to help them take the next one. Not by pressuring them.

By asking great questions, building trust quickly, and helping them understand whether a Discovery Visit is the right fit. If you love meaningful conversations, aren't afraid to talk about money, and get satisfaction from helping people finally take action, keep reading.

Quick Facts

  • Base: $50,000–$60,000
  • OTE: $75,000–$95,000+, uncapped commission
  • Leads: Semi-cold — new inquiries and older leads who went quiet, not cold prospecting
  • Volume: 80-100 outbound touchpoints/day across call, text, email, video
  • Tools: CRM-driven (Go High Level experience a plus); we track booking rate, show rate, and conversion quality weekly
  • Coaching: Weekly sales coaching, call reviews, and live role-play - this is a team that reviews our own performance and grows from it - every day - not just during onboarding.
  • Schedule: Eastern Time business hours, must be US-based and authorized to work in the US

About Us

CJ Physical Therapy & Pilates is a $1.5M cash-based physical therapy and regenerative wellness company helping active adults over 40 stay mobile, strong, and independent — without pills, injections, or surgery. We're 100% cash-based (no insurance, no referrals) and scaling from $1.5M to $2–3M over the next 2-3 years, building toward multi-location expansion.

The Role

You're not booking people who are already sold. You're working a pipeline of leads who expressed interest and then went quiet, plus fresh inquiries — and your job is structured, persistent follow-up until they either book and show up, or you get a clear no. That means:

  • Running 80-100 strategic touch points/day (call, text, email, video) against a defined lead list
  • Executing a structured follow-up cadence — not "reaching out until you get tired," a real system
  • Handling objections around cost, timing, skepticism, and past failed care
  • Setting expectations upfront that protect show rates (this isn't just booking, it's booking people who actually show up)
  • Confirming and reinforcing commitment before the visit
  • Keeping clean, accurate CRM documentation — pipeline hygiene matters here
  • Showing up to weekly coaching and call reviews ready to role-play, take feedback, and adjust your approach in real time

This is a metrics-driven seat. We track booking rate, show rate, and conversion quality closely, and we'll expect you to track, report on and own your own numbers too.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days:

  • 30+ qualified Discovery Visits booked/month
    • ​​​​​​​The clinician takes it from there. You simply make sure the right people get in front of them.
  • Confident, consistent objection handling
  • 90%+ Discovery Visit arrival rate
  • See 70%+ of your Discovery Visits move into a paid evaluation
  • Keep the CRM accurate and organized everyday​​​​​​​

First 12 months:

  • Consistent KPI performance
  • Bookings that convert into actual care plans, not just calendar fills
  • Real contribution to our growth from $1.5M to $2M+

Who Thrives Here

  • You've carried a real outbound quota before — calls, texts, emails, whatever the mix — and you know what a good day of activity looks like
  • You're organized enough to run a structured cadence across a lead list without letting people fall through the cracks
  • You can handle "I need to think about it" without flinching, and you know the difference between pressure and persistence
  • You're comfortable talking about premium pricing without apologizing for it
  • You want coaching — you're willing to get on a call, role-play a scenario, get direct feedback, and actually use it
  • You track your own numbers because you want to get better, not because someone's making you

Who This Isn't For

  • You need already-warm, ready-to-buy leads to hit your numbers
  • You rely on a script and get thrown off when the conversation goes off-book
  • You'd rather log activity than actually move someone toward a decision
  • You're looking for something more admin or scheduling-focused

Requirements

  • US-based, authorized to work in the US, available during Eastern Time business hours
  • 2+ years of outbound sales, SDR, or appointment-setting experience with a real high-volume call/text/email cadence
  • Proven track record hitting booking or revenue targets
  • Strong, demonstrable objection-handling ability
  • CRM experience (Go High Level a plus)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable with coaching, feedback, and role-play as part of the job — not just a one-time onboarding thing

Bonus: experience in health/wellness, elective medical, cash-based healthcare, or high-ticket service sales.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base: $50,000–$60,000
  • Uncapped commission | OTE $75,000–$95,000+ (top performers exceed this)
  • Health and dental insurance contribution
  • 401(k) with employer match after 1 year
  • Earned PTO + the week between Christmas and New Year's off
  • Weekly sales coaching, call reviews, and role-play
  • Travel opportunities for masterminds and events

Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. What We Do

First American Exchange Company is seeking a Senior Manager, Marketing Analytics & Growth Strategy to help lead the next phase of growth for a proven, high-performing marketing organization. Reporting to the Vice President, Marketing & Product Strategy, this newly created role will connect marketing activity to leads, completed exchanges, revenue and broader business outcomes; improve attribution and forecasting; and translate complex data into clear recommendations for senior leadership.

The Senior Manager will initially lead a two-person performance marketing function and directly manage the Marketing Campaign Manager. Together, the team will combine analytics, business insight and campaign execution to improve the performance of paid-media initiatives, particularly paid search. The Senior Manager will hold overall accountability for results and partner closely with the Campaign Manager to connect platform activity to 1031 Exchange business outcomes, generate deeper campaign insights, and continuously improve targeting, testing, optimization and return on investment.

The role will also advance the team’s use of AI, automation and emerging marketing technologies to improve strategy, execution, measurement and operating efficiency. The ideal candidate is a commercially minded marketing analytics leader who can find the story behind the numbers, lead collaborative teams, challenge assumptions and help leaders determine what to do next.

What You'll Do:

Marketing Analytics, Attribution and Forecasting

  • Analyze lead, customer, order, transaction, revenue and marketing data to identify trends, risks and growth opportunities.
  • Connect marketing programs to lead quality, conversion, completed orders, revenue, customer acquisition cost, cost per order and return on investment.
  • Lead the continued development of attribution, cohort reporting and performance measurement across media platforms, website activity, Salesforce and transaction data.
  • Establish consistent definitions, business logic and methodologies for funnel, channel and revenue reporting.
  • Develop lead, order and revenue forecasts using historical performance, customer behavior, market indicators and appropriate predictive techniques.
  • Translate complex analysis into concise executive summaries, business cases and actionable recommendations.

Performance Media Strategy and Team Leadership

  • Lead the performance media function, integrating analytics, strategy, campaign execution, testing and optimization around shared business goals.
  • Partner closely with the Marketing Campaign Manager to translate campaign, audience, lead, order and revenue data into actionable insights and performance improvements.
  • Own the overall performance of paid search and other performance media, while the Campaign Manager leads day-to-day campaign execution and optimization.

  • Evaluate media performance based on downstream business outcomes and recommend budget shifts, audience strategies, landing-page improvements and corrective actions.
  • Establish a strong operating rhythm for the function, including shared goals, regular performance reviews, business context, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

AI, Automation and Data Infrastructure

  • Identify and prioritize practical uses of AI and automation across analysis, reporting, attribution, forecasting, audience segmentation, campaign execution and customer engagement.
  • Automate repeatable reporting and marketing-operations processes to improve speed, consistency, scalability and resilience.
  • Improve dashboards, scorecards, automated alerts and data documentation while reducing manual work and key-person dependency.
  • Evaluate emerging marketing and analytics technologies based on business value, data readiness, implementation requirements and measurable return.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations, Salesforce, Product, Technology and enterprise data teams to improve data quality, system integration and workflow automation.
  • Establish appropriate standards for data privacy, validation, governance and human review of AI-generated analysis and consequential decisions.

Growth Strategy and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Marketing leadership to identify and prioritize opportunities for profitable growth across audiences, channels, products, partnerships and customer experiences.
  • Recommend where to increase investment, improve execution, test new approaches or discontinue underperforming activity.
  • Serve as the analytical partner to leaders across website, SEO, content, webinars, email, social media, Salesforce and marketing automation.
  • Align Marketing, Sales, Operations, Product and Finance around shared funnel definitions, reporting standards and business outcomes.
  • Influence decisions through collaboration, credibility and sound judgment, and translate technical or analytical concepts for nontechnical stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

  • Improve the reliability and usability of lead-to-order, attribution, revenue and forecasting reporting.
  • Establish clear channel-level customer acquisition cost, cost-per-order and downstream revenue measurement.
  • Improve paid-search and performance-media results through integrated analytics, strategy, execution and disciplined testing.
  • Build a high-performing performance media function that combines strong campaign execution with deeper customer, business and revenue insight.
  • Develop and begin executing a practical roadmap for AI and automation across marketing analytics, execution, measurement and operations.
  • Reduce manual reporting and dependence on individual institutional knowledge through scalable processes, documentation and automation.
  • Deliver analyses and recommendations that lead to measurable changes in strategy, investment, execution or business performance.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Degree emphasis in business, marketing, analytics, economics, finance, statistics, information systems or a related field is preferred.
  • Five to seven years of relevant experience, including a minimum of five years in digital marketing.
  • Experience leading significant analytical initiatives, cross-functional projects and team members is preferred.
  • Demonstrated readiness to operate at a Senior Manager level through strategic influence, executive communication and ownership of high-impact business decisions.
  • Strong experience in marketing analytics, business analytics, growth strategy, revenue operations, business intelligence or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and reconcile data from multiple systems and imperfect datasets and connect marketing activity to financial outcomes.
  • Experience with marketing attribution, cohort analysis, forecasting, customer acquisition cost and digital campaign measurement.
  • Strong working knowledge of paid search and performance media, including Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising and Performance Max.
  • Experience managing employees and leading collaborative teams that integrate analytics, strategy and campaign execution.
  • Experience with business intelligence and data-visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau or comparable platforms; strong Excel skills are required.
  • Experience with CRM or Salesforce data; SQL, Google Analytics and marketing automation experience are preferred.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled analytics, automation or marketing technology tools to improve business or marketing performance.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, privacy, governance, validation and appropriate human oversight when using AI and automation.
  • Exceptional executive communication, presentation, cross-functional leadership and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in financial services, real estate, title insurance, 1031 exchanges or another transaction-oriented business is helpful but not required.

This is an opportunity to shape a newly created, highly visible leadership role within a successful and collaborative marketing team. Exchange Marketing has built strong digital programs, an engaged audience, a successful education and webinar platform, expanding website and Salesforce capabilities, and increasingly sophisticated performance measurement.

The Senior Manager will help connect and scale those capabilities, lead a high-performing analytics and performance media function, introduce new automation opportunities, and play a critical role in helping the company accelerate growth and outperform the competition. The role offers meaningful business challenges, broad cross-functional influence and the opportunity to grow into wider leadership responsibilities as the organization evolves.

jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Software Engineer - k6 Core

The Opportunity:

At k6, we build reliability and performance testing tools for developers and QA engineers.

Grafana k6 is an open-source project focused on making performance testing practical, approachable, and useful in real-world engineering workflows. We care deeply about developer experience, correctness, and scalability. k6 is part of the Grafana ecosystem and is used by engineers to test and understand systems under real load.

What You’ll Be Doing:

You will join a team of engineers responsible for building and maintaining k6, a performance testing tool written in Go. The team also maintains the open-source project, which means working directly on the product, the codebase, and with the community using it.

In this role, you will work on features and improvements across the k6 codebase, from initial idea through implementation and delivery. Much of the work involves problems that are not fully specified up front and require understanding the context, evaluating trade-offs, and choosing a reasonable technical approach.

You will work with a high degree of independence while collaborating closely with other engineers on design, implementation, and code reviews. You are expected to deliver production-quality code, maintain existing functionality, and help keep the system reliable and maintainable over time.

Some work may involve the k6 cloud offering, which builds on top of k6 to run distributed tests across data centers worldwide. This includes Go services that support distributed execution and require careful attention to performance, correctness, and failure modes.

Because the team is small, your work will have a direct and visible impact on the product and its users. You will work alongside experienced engineers in an environment that values clarity, pragmatism, and sound engineering judgment.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

We start with problems, not prescriptions. Engineers are expected to understand the constraints, propose a pragmatic design, and carry the work through to delivery. We move deliberately and release on a regular cadence of roughly every six weeks. Between releases, we focus on small, safe, incremental changes.

Work is asynchronous by default, with decisions captured in pull requests and short design notes. Meetings are used for alignment rather than status updates. Code reviews focus on correctness, long-term maintainability, and user impact. When trade-offs are required, we aim to make them explicit and reversible. The team owns the product end to end, including architecture, releases, user-facing behavior, and the health of the open-source project.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer with strong programming skills and a track record of working on non-trivial systems.

You should have:

  • Strong experience building production software in Go, or another language with good support for concurrency and parallelism
  • Experience working on larger or long-lived codebases
  • The ability to work independently on scoped problems and deliver them to completion
  • Clear technical communication skills, especially in code reviews and design discussions
  • A good understanding of internet protocols such as HTTP, gRPC, and WebSockets, with some familiarity with lower-level networking concepts
  • Experience with modern development practices, including testing, code review, and iterative development

Bonus Points For:

You do not need experience with everything listed below. These are areas where familiarity is useful for the role, and the more you bring, the easier the ramp-up will be:

  • Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects
  • Prior experience using k6 in production, or contributing to the k6 project or ecosystem
  • Performance, reliability, or network testing and optimization
  • Distributed systems or cloud-based services
  • JavaScript and/or TypeScript
  • Backend systems for web or mobile applications
  • Tools and platforms such as Docker, AWS, microservices architectures, and observability tools like Grafana or APM systems

Compensation & Rewards:

In Spain, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 82,988- EUR 99,586. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.description:
About the Role

At Jumio, the Software Development Engineer IV - QA (SDE-IV, QA) is a senior technical role focused on ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of highly scalable web portals and distributed backend systems. Our platform spans multiple Java Spring Boot microservices and customer-facing web portals, deployed across AWS ECS, EKS, and Lambda, and integrated through event-driven messaging using SNS/SQS.

In this role you will design and drive the test automation strategy for both UI (Playwright) and API/service layers, set the quality bar for the team, and act as a force multiplier — mentoring other engineers and embedding quality earlier in the development lifecycle. You will work closely with development, product, and DevOps teams to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality, scalability, and security.

This is a hands-on senior IC role: you will write code, but you will also influence architecture, own cross-service test strategy, and make build-vs-buy decisions for testing tooling.

T-Shaped Engineering Expectation

As part of Jumio's engineering culture, you will adopt a T-shaped engineering approach. Beyond deep expertise in test automation and quality engineering, you will contribute across the development lifecycle — understanding software architecture, participating in design and API-contract discussions, reviewing application code, and ensuring our distributed systems are testable, observable, and resilient by design.

Role Value

This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of Jumio's products. By architecting and maintaining automated testing frameworks across web, API, and event-driven layers, you will enable faster, higher-confidence releases and reduce production risk in a complex microservices environment.

What You'll Do

Test Architecture & Strategy

  • Define and own the end-to-end automated test strategy across web portals and backend microservices, balancing UI, API, contract, integration, and end-to-end coverage (test pyramid).
  • Design test strategies for distributed, event-driven systems — including asynchronous flows through SNS/SQS, eventual consistency, idempotency, message ordering, retries, and dead-letter handling.

Automation Engineering

  • Develop and maintain robust test automation frameworks for web (Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent) and API testing, using Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Automate API and service-level testing (REST/JSON, and async messaging) to validate functionality, performance, and resilience.
  • Build maintainable, scalable framework abstractions (page objects, fixtures, data builders, reusable test harnesses) that other engineers adopt.

Cloud-Native & Non-Functional Testing

  • Design tests that run against services deployed on ECS, EKS, and Lambda, including environment provisioning and teardown.
  • Use tools like TestContainers / LocalStack to test AWS integrations (SQS/SNS, Lambda, etc.) reliably and locally.
  • Drive performance, load, and resilience testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust) for highly scalable services, and partner with engineering on results and bottlenecks.
  • Contribute to non-functional quality: basic security testing, reliability, and chaos/failure-injection where appropriate.

CI/CD & Quality Engineering

  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions / Jenkins / GitLab CI) to enable fast feedback and continuous delivery.
  • Improve test reliability — reduce flakiness, optimize execution time, enable parallelization, and improve observability of test results.
  • Define and track quality metrics (coverage, escape rate, MTTR, flake rate) and use them to drive decisions.

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Leverage LLM-based tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate test authoring, framework development, test-data generation, and debugging — driving measurable productivity and coverage gains.
  • Apply AI to quality engineering workflows: generating and maintaining test cases from requirements/specs, summarizing failures and triaging flaky tests, reviewing code, and scaffolding boilerplate so the team focuses on high-value testing.
  • Champion responsible, effective AI adoption within the QA team — establishing prompts, patterns, and guardrails, and mentoring engineers on using these tools to work faster without compromising rigor or correctness.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with developers to ensure comprehensive coverage and efficient issue resolution; review application and test code.
  • Mentor and uplevel SDE-II/III QA engineers on automation best practices, framework design, and testing strategy.
  • Influence design and architecture discussions to make systems more testable and to shift quality left.
  • Continuously evaluate and introduce new tools, methodologies, and best practices.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong programming skills in Java (Spring Boot ecosystem) and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Playwright (and/or Selenium) for web automation.
  • Proven experience testing microservices and API-based systems, including async/event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS or equivalent messaging — Kafka/RabbitMQ a plus).
  • Experience testing cloud-native applications on AWS (ECS, EKS, Lambda) and familiarity with containers/Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Solid grasp of CI/CD, test integration, and pipeline quality gates.
  • Experience with performance/load testing and non-functional quality.
  • Experience with API automation tools (e.g., Postman, REST-assured) and a good understanding of REST APIs.
  • Basic knowledge of UNIX/Linux systems and scripting.
  • A problem-solving mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to drive quality decisions and mentor others in a fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience using LLM/AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to improve engineering productivity, with good judgment on where AI accelerates work and where human review is essential.

Nice to Have

  • Contract testing (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code familiarity (Terraform/CloudFormation) and observability tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).
  • Experience in identity verification, KYC/AML, or other security/compliance-sensitive domains.
  • Experience building or testing LLM/AI-powered features, or integrating AI into test automation and CI/CD workflows.

Jumio Values:

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

Equal Opportunities:

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

About Jumio:

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to .
