jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Principal, Pharmacovigilance / Device Vigilance is a detail-oriented and proactive professional supporting the safety surveillance of In Vitro Diagnostic and Software-driven products across their lifecycle, including clinical studies and post-market activities. This role is responsible for the collection, assessment, reporting, and management of adverse events, product complaints, and safety data for both medicinal products and medical devices, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.

The position plays a critical role in ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EU IVDR, Japan) and maintaining the highest standards of patient safety and product quality across both laboratory-developed tests and regulated IVD products, including software/algorithm-based components.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Pharmacovigilance (Drug Safety)

    • Perform case intake, triage, and processing of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs)

    • Process and evaluate adverse events associated with diagnostic use (e.g., clinical impact of false positives/negatives)

    • Coordinate medical review and causality assessment of adverse events

    • Coordinate timely submission of safety reports (e.g., MedWatch, EudraVigilance, CIOMS)

    • Support aggregate reporting (PSUR/PBRER, DSUR, annual reports)

    • Maintain and ensure compliance with global PV regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, etc.)

    • Contribute to signal detection and risk management activities

  • IVD Device Vigilance

    • Review, triage, and assess product complaints and adverse events related to genetic and diagnostic testing, including incorrect, delayed, or misinterpreted results

    • Evaluate reportability of events under FDA (MDR), EU IVDR vigilance, Japan and other global regulations

    • Prepare and submit Medical Device Reports (MDRs) and vigilance reports within regulatory timelines

    • Collaborate with laboratory operations, bioinformatics, and software teams to investigate root cause (e.g., assay performance, variant interpretation, software defects)

    • Support post-market surveillance activities, including trending, signal detection, and periodic safety reporting

  • Software & Algorithm-Related Safety

    • Assess safety events associated with software as part of a medical device system, including algorithm errors, data processing issues, and reporting inaccuracies

    • Partner with engineering and data science teams to evaluate software-related complaints and implement corrective actions

    • Contribute to risk management activities (e.g., hazard analysis, risk files, FMEA updates) for software and integrated diagnostic systems

  • Cross-Functional & Compliance

    • Ensure compliance with SOPs, GVP, and applicable quality systems (QMS)

    • Partner with Clinical, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Medical Affairs teams

    • Support audits and inspections (internal and external)

    • Maintain accurate documentation in safety databases

    • Assist in vendor oversight (e.g., CROs, safety service providers)

    • Other duties as assigned

    • Ability to provide support outside of standard business hours for expedited reporting requirements as needed

​

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Required

    • Bachelor’s degree in life science field (biology, microbiology, chemistry, engineering, medical technology, regulatory science, etc.) or equivalent. Advanced degree in life sciences (MS, PhD, etc.) and/or MBA preferred.

      RAC preferred.

      Minimum of 12 years of direct applicable experience in pharmacovigilance and/or device vigilance

    • Strong knowledge of global safety regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, EU IVDR, Japan)

    • Experience with safety databases (e.g., AEMS, Argus, ARISg, Veeva Safety)

    • Familiarity with MedDRA coding and case processing workflows

    • Knowledge of applicable standards, including ISO 13485 and ISO 14971

  • Preferred

    • Advanced degree (PharmD, MD, MPH, MSc)

    • Experience in diagnostics or combination products

    • Prior audit/inspection experience

    • RAC, PV certification, or similar credentials

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience with global markets is highly desirable

  • Strong analytical and clinical assessment skills

  • Attention to detail and regulatory compliance mindset

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Cross-functional collaboration

  • Demonstrated self-starter and highly motivated, energetic and enthusiastic.

  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion within a broadly defined range of policies and practices, which includes analytical problem solving.

  • Demonstrated organizational, planning, and program management skills, including action oriented, focused urgency and driving for results.

  • Ability to be effective in complex projects with ambiguity and/or rapid change

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including ability to communicate across cultures

  • work with others in a team environment; effective interactions with technical and medical personnel.

  • Computer literacy (PC, Microsoft Office and Google Workspace).

Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection.

You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

  • Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.

  • Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why.

  • Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.

  • Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.

  • Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, specifically in a Growth-focused role.

  • Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).

  • Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.

  • SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.

  • Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.

  • Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.

  • Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.

  • Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.

  • Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing, SEO, and paid acquisition channels.

  • Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).

  • Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities.

  • Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine.

  • Unlimited PTO – We value results over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

  • Coworking Budget – $200/month to rent a coworking space.

  • Hardware Budget – Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal computer.

  • Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth.

  • Annual Company Off-sites – Connect with your teammates in person at various locations around the globe.

Ready to move the needle? Apply now and show us how you’d build the future of student growth.

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription.

jobs.description:
About CDI

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation.

About the Role

CDI is seeking a strategic, media-savvy communicator to serve as Vice President of Strategic Communications. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, the VP will be responsible for establishing CDI as the leading national voice on constructive dialogue in higher education and converting that visibility into audience growth and organizational credibility.

This is a hands-on builder role. The VP will lead CDI's communications strategy, earned media, executive profile-building, messaging and narrative, editorial leadership of CDI's thought leadership and newsletter, organic social, and crisis and reputation management. Initially, the VP will operate as an individual contributor supported by fractional and contractor resources. Over time, the VP will manage a Communications & Content Manager, who will serve as the editorial and production engine for owned content.

The ideal candidate brings 10–12 years of experience in strategic communications, strong relationships across national and higher education media, and a track record of building organizational reputation in complex, high-stakes environments.

Responsibilities

Lead CDI's communications strategy and narrative

  • Set the annual communications and thought leadership strategy, defining editorial priorities and narrative direction in service of CDI's mission and earned revenue goals.

  • Serve as a trusted communications advisor to the Executive Director and Chief Growth Officer, helping assess trade-offs, evaluate reputational risk, and align leadership on key messaging decisions before work advances.

  • Own CDI's messaging guide and narrative framework, ensuring consistent, politically grounded communication across all external channels.

  • Monitor CDI's reputational landscape — including dynamics around partners, founders, and key stakeholders — alongside political, cultural, and higher education trends, to proactively identify risks and opportunities and advise leadership.

Elevate CDI's executive and thought leadership profile

  • Lead CDI's executive visibility program, building the Executive Director and other key CDI figures' profiles through op-eds, podcast appearances, conference keynotes, and media placements, and preparing and coaching the Executive Director for public appearances and interviews.

  • Partner with CDI's thought-leadership bench (across the Research, Education, Culture Change teams) to translate research findings into media-ready narratives and public-facing content.

Build and own CDI's earned media presence

  • Drive proactive media outreach to national, higher education, and mission-aligned press; build and maintain relationships with journalists, editors, and influencers.

  • Lead rapid response and crisis communications, managing reputational risk with speed and sound judgment.

Lead owned media and editorial

  • Provide editorial leadership for CDI's higher education newsletter and blog; manage the Communications & Content Manager to maintain publishing cadence and quality.

  • Own organic social strategy (brand, executive, and thought-leadership content), with the Communications & Content Manager executing the unified calendar.

  • Coordinate the thought-leadership editorial calendar with the Impact team, Partnerships, and the thought-leadership bench.

Support external relationships and cross-functional work

  • Support CDI's broader external relationships — including with funders, board members, and senior institutional partners — by ensuring CDI's communications reflect the organization's impact, credibility, and strategic direction.

  • Partner with the Senior Manager of Demand Generation to connect comms outputs — earned media, newsletter audience, thought leadership — to Marketing Qualified Pipeline, ensuring visibility translates into partnerships opportunities and earned revenue.

Build and lead the communications team

  • Manage the Communications & Content Manager, providing editorial direction, coaching, and prioritization.

  • Establish the communications operating model: workflows, editorial planning system, brand standards, and cross-functional feedback loops.

  • Define and track the communications scorecard: 25 earned placements and 100 mentions annually; 30% year-over-year audience growth across the HE newsletter and LinkedIn; two research studies each yielding at least one feature placement.

Requirements

About You

  • Senior communications leader: 10–12 years of experience in strategic communications, or PR, with demonstrated success building organizational reputation and growing audiences in complex, politically sensitive environments.

  • Media relationships: Established connections across national, higher education, and mission-aligned press; track record of securing high-quality placements.

  • Exceptional judgment: Deep instinct for when to engage — CDI's credibility depends on nonpartisan restraint as much as visibility. Proven track record protecting organizational reputation in politically sensitive environments while proactively shaping a positive organizational narrative, with the ability to clearly articulate trade-offs and advise leadership on risk.

  • Strong writer and editor: Track record producing or overseeing high-quality long-form thought leadership and executive communications.

  • Hands-on operator: Comfortable executing with speed, rigor, and attention to detail while building for scale; in a small organization, VP-level execution and follow-through are as important as vision.

  • Builder mindset: Experience establishing or significantly evolving a communications function, including processes, standards, and team structure; experience managing people in a startup or scaling organization.

  • Cross-functional collaborator: Proven ability to coordinate editorial and campaign work across research, marketing, and partnerships teams, and to align leadership before advancing work.

  • Mission-aligned: Deeply motivated by CDI's mission, with the political awareness to communicate constructively and credibly across ideological lines. Familiarity with the higher education landscape strongly preferred.

Benefits

  • Compensation —$175,000-$195,000 (based on experience)

  • A Mission-Driven Culture — our work culture genuinely reflects our mission, characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness

  • Remote-First — CDI was founded as a remote-first organization, and we work hard to maintain a strong team culture across vast distances

  • Unlimited PTO — As well as 13 company holidays

  • Other Benefits — Employer-supported health, vision, and dental plans, subsidized parental leave, 3% 401(k) match, short- and long-term disability insurance, life and AD&D insurance, and a $1,000 annual professional development budget.

Role Specs

  • Reports to: Chief Growth Officer

  • Direct Reports: None currently; expected to build a small communications team over time as the function scales

  • Schedule: Full-time, flexible within U.S. time zones

  • Target start date: ASAP

  • Location: Remote, must be based in the U.S.

Highlights

CDI is seeking a VP of Strategic Comms to establish CDI as the leading national voice on constructive dialogue in higher education through earned media, executive visibility, and thought leadership.

jobs.description:
As part of SIDE’s Global Player Support organisation, you will manage the Zendesk environment supporting a multilingual, global player support operation.

This is a hands-on role covering platform administration, workflow design, Help Center development, reporting, integrations, and continuous improvement. You will work with Operations, Quality, Training, Reporting, Technology, and client stakeholders to turn business requirements into practical and scalable Zendesk solutions.

You will be responsible for keeping the platform stable, secure, and well governed while improving agent productivity, player experience, self-service, and operational visibility.

Requirements

What You’ll Be Doing

Zendesk Administration and Workflow Management

  • Administer and maintain ticket forms, custom fields, views, macros, triggers, automations, routing rules, business rules, SLAs, groups, organizations, and user roles.
  • Manage user onboarding, offboarding, permissions, and access controls in line with security requirements.
  • Design and improve workflows that support efficient ticket handling and reduce unnecessary manual effort.
  • Ensure platform configurations remain scalable, documented, and aligned with approved operational requirements.

Help Center and Self-Service

  • Design, customize, and maintain Zendesk Guide and player-facing Help Center experiences.
  • Develop responsive Help Center themes using HTML, Handlebars, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and JSON.
  • Improve navigation, ticket-entry points, and self-service journeys while maintaining client branding and accessibility standards.
  • Test and validate Help Center and front-end changes before deployment.

Reporting and Integrations

  • Partner with the Reporting team to build and maintain Zendesk Explore dashboards covering SLAs, productivity, customer satisfaction, backlog, quality, and other operational KPIs.
  • Maintain fields and data-capture processes that support accurate and consistent reporting.
  • Manage integrations between Zendesk, Jira, and other approved systems, including ticket escalation, field mapping, status synchronization, and communication workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve reporting, integration, data-sync, and workflow issues affecting support operations.

Change Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Assess the risks, dependencies, and downstream impact of proposed platform changes.
  • Coordinate testing, documentation, communication, and controlled deployment of approved enhancements.
  • Review the wider Zendesk ecosystem—including workflows, reporting, automation, integrations, knowledge management, and self-service—to identify inefficiencies and service gaps.
  • Develop and present a prioritized improvement roadmap outlining recommendations, expected outcomes, implementation approaches, and success measures.

What You’ll Bring

  • Two to five years of experience administering Zendesk Support in a production environment.
  • Practical experience configuring forms, fields, triggers, automations, macros, views, routing logic, business rules, and SLAs.
  • Experience maintaining Zendesk Guide themes using HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, Handlebars, and JSON.
  • Experience building or supporting operational dashboards and reports using Zendesk Explore.
  • Experience maintaining Zendesk–Jira integrations and troubleshooting platform, workflow, or data-synchronization issues.
  • Experience supporting Customer Support, Player Support, Customer Experience, or a similar service operation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Zendesk Administrator Certification or another relevant Zendesk certification.
  • Familiarity with Zendesk, Jira, or REST APIs, as well as Git or another version-control system.
  • Experience supporting gaming, SaaS, or high-volume support operations, including platform implementations, migrations, or transformation programs.

A portfolio demonstrating previous Zendesk work is preferred. Redacted screenshots, diagrams, dashboards, workflow designs, or anonymized examples are acceptable.

Shortlisted candidates may also be asked to complete and discuss a practical Zendesk case study based on a real-world player support scenario.

Keys for Success

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Maintain a stable, secure, and well-governed Zendesk environment.
  • Deliver measurable improvements to operational efficiency, self-service, and player experience.
  • Maintain reliable reporting and effective collaboration between Zendesk, Jira, and operational teams.
  • Implement changes and improvement initiatives with clear documentation and minimal disruption to live operations

Its Healthcare and Life Sciences business is entering a deliberate scale phase built on strong domain capabilities, global delivery and established relationships across regulated industries.

The platform currently includes dedicated leaders for Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices. This newly created role will sit between those leaders and the Chief Business Officer, providing integrated commercial direction across the portfolio while keeping Life Sciences as the primary growth engine.

Sector priorities

Life Sciences, the primary focus

The successful executive will bring current, credible and commercially useful knowledge across pharma and biotech, CROs and CDMOs, consumer health and the broader life sciences value chain. Relevant areas include discovery and development, clinical trials, regulatory and quality, manufacturing and supply chain, commercial launch, patient services, data and AI, cloud modernization, enterprise applications and digital operating models.

Medical Devices and MedTech

The role will also support growth with device and diagnostics companies through connected products, software and platform engineering, product lifecycle services, intelligent validation, quality and regulatory assurance, smart manufacturing, supply chain transformation and digital health.

Healthcare

Relevant healthcare experience may span payers, providers, pharmacy benefit managers and HealthTech. Priority themes include patient and member experience, core platform modernization, interoperability, data and analytics, responsible AI, value based care, operational optimization and secure cloud native transformation.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the growth agenda. Set the commercial strategy, priority markets, target account architecture and investment choices required to achieve the portfolio ambition.

  • Run a rigorous pipeline. Establish clear qualification, account prioritization, forecasting, deal governance and conversion disciplines. Maintain visibility into revenue, margin, risk and resource needs.
  • Develop leadership capacity. Coach senior sales and sector leaders, raise standards for consultative selling and create a collaborative culture that connects front end growth with delivery excellence.
  • Expand selectively. Use existing relationships when they can unlock substantial new programs, but keep the role centered on new revenue rather than routine farming or account administration.

Required experience

  • Approximately 15 or more years of progressive enterprise sales, business leadership or market development experience, including significant responsibility in global technology services, digital engineering, consulting or a highly relevant enterprise product organization.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Content Creator, you will be the face and hands behind SentinelOne's short-form video content — shooting, editing and publishing platform-native videos that bring fresh, culture-forward storytelling from consumer, sports and political media into the cybersecurity space. You live in front of and behind the camera, you know how to make an audience stop scrolling in the first three seconds, and you turn complex security topics into content people actually want to watch.

This role has two paths depending on your background. If you bring technical or cybersecurity fluency, you'll also take the lead on growing and moderating our presence in community spaces like Reddit and Discord — building direct relationships with the practitioner audiences who live there. If your strength is video and storytelling rather than deep technical chops, you'll focus primarily on content production — but an interest in (or aptitude for) community management is a significant plus and something we're eager to develop in this role over time.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Short-form video, first and foremost: Concept, shoot, edit and publish high-volume, platform-native video content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts, LinkedIn video and beyond) that translates cybersecurity topics into content with real cultural relevance
  • Own the on-camera presence: Be a consistent, recognizable voice for SentinelOne on social media. You are comfortable hosting, reacting, interviewing and improvising in front of a camera, not just producing content for others to appear in
  • Community engagement: Respond to and engage with customers, partners and security influencers across SentinelOne's channels and the broader social ecosystem
  • Drive cross-functional content strategy: Partner with demand generation, field marketing, threat intelligence, product marketing, talent brand and other teams, translating their objectives into video and social content that performs
  • Experimentation and growth: Stay on top of evolving platform features, formats and creator trends; borrow liberally from what's working in sports, consumer and political social to identify and test novel ways to grow SentinelOne's audience and community
  • Analytics & reporting: Work with comms leadership and the social media team to establish meaningful performance indicators and report on always-on content as well as specific campaigns

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • A demonstrated track record as a hands-on, on-camera content creator — you can shoot, edit, write and publish short-form video without waiting on an agency or production team (a portfolio or reel is a must)
  • 2–5 years of experience creating content for a brand, publication, campaign or your own channel(s), ideally with time in or adjacent to consumer brands, sports media, political communications, entertainment, or directly within the cybersecurity ecosystem
  • Deep understanding of what makes video travel on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and X — including platform-specific formats, algorithms and audience behaviors
  • Technical or cybersecurity background and experience building or engaging with online communities (Reddit, Discord, Twitch, forums) is highly desired — candidates with this combination will expand community management capabilities as part of this role
  • Comfort translating complex, technical ideas into content that a broad audience wants to watch — cybersecurity expertise is a strong plus, but not a prerequisite for the video-first version of this role
  • Exceptional storytelling instincts, with range across tones (authoritative, punchy, human, urgent) and formats (talking-head, skits, interviews, reactive/trend content)
  • Proficiency with content creation and editing tools (e.g. CapCut, Edits, Premiere, Adobe Creative Suite) as well as social/community management tools and AI applications
  • Highly organized, self-directed and able to manage multiple workstreams and a consistent publishing cadence without losing quality or speed
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Media, or a related field — or equivalent experience building an audience/community independently

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. jobs.excerpt: Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp CertifiedTrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.
jobs.description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.
Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.
We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.
But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.
At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.
The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

Fifty million people in the UK and US alone could be Trusted Housesitters members. Around forty thousand people land on trustedhousesitters.com every day. What happens next - whether they trust us enough to sign up, and what we do to help them succeed once they have - is one of the most interesting analytical challenges we have right now. This role owns that: what happens once someone's actually inside the product.

You'll own the analytics for our new member revenue product squads. Own the journey, own the experiments on it, own the recommendations that come out of it. You'll be the person who doesn't just explain what happened in the data - you'll have a point of view on what to do about it. We're looking for someone who goes looking for the questions nobody's asked yet.

What you'll actually be doing

  • Own the growth analytics for our new member revenue squads - acquisition funnel, conversion, product usage, the works - and build a picture of what's actually driving (or blocking) that journey.
  • Spot opportunities in the data before anyone asks you to look. Turn them into recommendations that change what gets built, not just what gets reported
  • Lead instrumentation on new features - defining tracking, success metrics, and guardrail metrics before anything ships, not after
  • Design and run A/B and multivariate experiments on the product itself - page layouts, signup flows, onboarding journey - end-to-end from hypothesis through to decision-ready insight. Set the standard for how experimentation works across the product squads
  • Build the dashboards and self-serve reporting that means stakeholders can answer their own questions - and you spend less time running the same queries every Monday
  • Challenge assumptions. Act as the analytical voice in the room when product and commercial decisions are being made. Be the comfortable person saying "I don't think that's what the data shows"
  • Mentor other analysts and help raise the analytical bar across the team - in SQL, in experimentation, in how we tell a story with numbers

What we're looking for

  • Solid product analytics experience in a subscription, marketplace, SaaS, or platform business - where the funnel is complex, and the metrics actually matter
  • The ability to own end-to-end analysis for a product area, from scoping through to recommendation, with minimal direction
  • Advanced SQL. You're not reaching for documentation for standard analytical patterns. dbt experience is a genuine plus
  • Good understanding of user event tracking (Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar) - you're comfortable defining new events to support release of new product features, and to enable future analysis and reporting.
  • Solid understanding of experimentation - hypothesis design, A/B and multivariate testing, statistical significance, the places where naive analysis goes wrong. And experience applying it, not just describing it
  • Fluency in product metrics: conversion, activation, churn - and how those numbers connect to things the business actually cares about
  • Strong data storytelling. You can explain what the numbers mean to a product manager, and also to a CFO. Different rooms, different language, same rigour
  • Product instincts. This isn't just an analytics role. We want someone who generates ideas, not just validates them

Nice to have

  • Python or R for more advanced modelling or automation
  • Experience integrating AI tools into analytical workflows in a way that's actually made a difference

You might feel like a fish out of water if...

    We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

    Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

    With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply.

    You're most comfortable when the question is handed to you. This role needs someone who goes looking for the question. If your best work tends to happen when a stakeholder has defined the problem clearly, and you're building the analysis to answer it - that's a genuinely valuable skill, just not quite the shape of this one.

    You think of experimentation as a process to follow, not a discipline to own. We're not looking for someone who can run an A/B test to spec. We're looking for someone who'll push back when the experiment is designed badly, mentor others through the parts they get wrong, and build the frameworks that make the whole team better at it.

    You're most excited by media spend and channel strategy. This role sits inside the product, not the media plan - if deciding where ad budget goes, or building attribution and channel-mix models, is the part that lights you up, this wouldn't be the right fit on this occasion

    You're happiest when the business is stable, and the roadmap is fixed. THS is growing fast, and the product is evolving constantly. The analytical picture shifts. Priorities shift. That's the job - and if predictability is important to how you do your best work, it's worth naming that upfront.

    If you're reading this and one of those points resonates, and you're sitting there thinking "that's me, but I know I can make it work" - we'd love to hear why. Send a Cover letter. There's a human at the heart of every decision we make here (hi!) - and we'll always take the time to review applications for anyone who wants to join us.

The Process

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Intro call (~20 mins) - with the Talent team. A two-way conversation: we'll tell you more about the role and THS, you tell us about your background and what you're looking for

    2. Hiring manager interview (~30 mins) - with the Product Analytics Lead. Covering your analytical experience, approach to experimentation, and how you think about growth problems

    3. Take-home task (~1-.5 hours) - a short analytical exercise. We'll share a brief in advance and give you time to work through it at your own pace

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed twice a year
  • Generous equity package
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus
If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a CRO Specialist, you will own the day-to-day execution of our web experimentation program - and to be the analytical engine that powers it. This role sits within our broader Web UX team and is responsible for the full testing lifecycle: from behavioral research and hypothesis development to experiment setup, QA, and post-test reporting.

You'll be our resident expert in Webflow Optimize, a close partner to the Manager of UX Design & CRO, and the person who ensures every experiment we run is well-designed, rigorously tracked, and thoroughly documented. This isn't just a button-pushing role; we're looking for someone who brings genuine curiosity about user behavior, strong analytical instincts, and the operational discipline to keep a high-velocity testing program running smoothly.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

Behavioral Research & Insight

  • Analyze heatmaps, session recordings, FullStory, and GA4 to identify friction points, drop-off patterns, and conversion opportunities across the site
  • Document behavioral findings and translate them into clear, prioritized observations that inform test ideas, UX improvements, and design decisions
  • Surface insights to the broader web team to contribute to UX strategy — not just the testing pipeline

Test Ideation & Hypothesis Development

  • Generate data-backed test ideas and write structured hypotheses that clearly articulate the problem, proposed change, and expected outcome
  • Collaborate with the Manager to align the test backlog with the CRO strategy and business priorities
  • Track prior experiments to build on learnings and avoid redundancy

Testing Roadmap & Pipeline Execution

  • Own and maintain the monthly testing roadmap, keeping it accurate and prioritized
  • Manage every test through the full pipeline - brief, Asana ticket creation, design coordination, dev handoff, QA, launch, and monitoring
  • Maintain clear documentation and ticket hygiene so stakeholders always have visibility into test status

Experiment Setup & QA

  • Configure all experiments in Webflow Optimize, including audience segmentation, traffic allocation, goal tracking, and variant logic
  • Own pre-launch QA across devices and browsers, verifying tracking, rendering, and experiment logic
  • Monitor live tests for data quality and flag anomalies or early signals to the Manager

Webflow Optimize Expertise

  • Serve as the team's go-to expert on Webflow Optimize - understanding its full capabilities and best practices
  • Stay current on platform updates and proactively identify ways to run more sophisticated experiments
  • Train or support other team members on the tool as needed

Reporting & Knowledge Management

  • Write a detailed post-test report for every experiment - results, statistical significance, segment analysis, and a clear win/loss/inconclusive call
  • Maintain the CRO testing deck as an organized, up-to-date knowledge base that the wider company can reference
  • Partner with the Manager on site-wide KPI tracking and contribute to monthly and quarterly performance reporting

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 2-4 years of experience in CRO, digital marketing, UX research, or web analytics
  • Hands-on experience setting up and managing A/B tests in an experimentation platform (Webflow Optimize, Optimizely, VWO, or similar)
  • Proficiency with behavioral analytics tools (FullStory, Hotjar, or equivalent) and comfort with heatmaps and session recordings
  • Working knowledge of GA4 for funnel analysis and performance tracking
  • Strong written communication skills - able to write clear hypotheses, experiment briefs, and post-test reports
  • Organized and process-oriented, with experience managing multiple workstreams or projects simultaneously
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret experiment data and translate it into actionable recommendations
  • Experience working within a B2B SaaS or enterprise marketing organization

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Quality Engineer to provide technical quality engineering support for materials, pressure-retaining components, supplier activities, and ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code compliance, and to help ensure that items and services are specified, procured, tested, documented, and accepted with the rigor needed to support safe and reliable nuclear projects.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Quality Engineer to provide technical quality engineering support for materials, pressure-retaining components, supplier activities, and ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code compliance, and to help ensure that items and services are specified, procured, tested, documented, and accepted with the rigor needed to support safe and reliable nuclear projects.

Position Description

The Quality Engineer will serve as a technical quality resource for the implementation and execution of Oklo's Quality Assurance Program in accordance with ASME NQA-1, ANSI/ANS-15.8, applicable ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code requirements, contractual and regulatory requirements, and Oklo procedures. This role will work closely with Engineering, Procurement, Supplier Quality, Project Quality, suppliers, laboratories, and fabrication organizations to translate code and material requirements into practical controls; verify material specifications and test requirements; review and manage certified material test reports; support material traceability and special process controls; and develop a robust Certifying Engineer Program. The successful candidate will be a hands-on quality engineer who can interpret complex technical requirements, evaluate objective evidence, resolve material and certification issues, and make clear, defensible quality decisions in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Support the implementation, maintenance, assessment, and continuous improvement of quality engineering controls in accordance with ASME NQA-1, ANSI/ANS-15.8, applicable ASME BPVC requirements, project specifications, contractual commitments, and Oklo procedures.
  • Serve as a technical quality resource for ASME BPVC matters; guide cross-functional discussions on applicable Code requirements, material and fabrication provisions, Code Cases, certification expectations, and the practical application of those requirements to Oklo items and services.
  • Review drawings, design specifications, procurement specifications, requisitions, purchase orders, and supplier documents to verify that applicable Code, material, testing, inspection, documentation, traceability, and quality assurance requirements are clearly identified and effectively flowed down.
  • Ensure materials conform to applicable ASME, ASTM, SA/SB, and project specifications by verifying material grade, product form, dimensions, condition, heat treatment, chemical composition, mechanical properties, supplementary requirements, identification, marking, and heat or lot traceability.
  • Establish, administer, and continuously improve the certified material test report program, including receipt, logging, technical review, approval status, discrepancy control, linkage to procured items, retention, retrieval, and turnover of CMTRs and supporting material records.
  • Analyze CMTRs, material test reports, certificates of conformance, laboratory reports, heat-treatment records, NDE reports, and related objective evidence for completeness, authenticity, traceability, specification compliance, and consistency with purchase-order and design requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance on material testing and acceptance strategies, including chemical analysis, positive material identification, tensile testing, impact testing, hardness testing, metallography, corrosion testing, nondestructive examination, and pressure or leak testing, as applicable; define acceptance criteria, sampling bases, witness or hold points, and qualified laboratory expectations.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain a Certifying Engineer Program that defines responsibilities, authority, independence, competency requirements, training, qualification, authorization, periodic requalification, performance monitoring, records, and escalation expectations for personnel certifying technical compliance.
  • Perform or coordinate technical reviews supporting Certifying Engineer decisions and verify that certifications are based on complete and accurate objective evidence, unresolved discrepancies are appropriately controlled, and approval authority is exercised independently and consistently.
  • Support qualification, evaluation, and oversight of material organizations, ASME certificate holders, component manufacturers, fabricators, testing laboratories, heat-treatment providers, NDE organizations, and other suppliers performing work that affects material or pressure-boundary quality.
  • Provide quality engineering oversight of special processes, including welding, brazing, heat treatment, nondestructive examination, forming, machining, cleaning, coating, and other controlled fabrication activities; review procedures, personnel qualifications, process qualifications, essential variables, and resulting records for compliance.
  • Develop and maintain inspection and test plans, quality requirement matrices, material control and traceability procedures, receiving inspection criteria, surveillance plans, review checklists, and hold or witness points that translate technical requirements into clear and verifiable acceptance activities.
  • Participate in design, procurement, supplier, fabrication, and readiness reviews to identify Code interfaces, material risks, testing needs, acceptance methods, documentation requirements, and quality controls early enough to prevent rework, delays, or loss of traceability.
  • Evaluate nonconformance reports, deviations, substitutions, and material discrepancies; support technically sound dispositions, root cause and extent-of-condition evaluations, corrective actions, and effectiveness reviews; and verify that approved dispositions are properly implemented and documented.
  • Support commercial grade dedication activities for materials and components, as applicable, by helping identify critical characteristics, acceptance criteria, verification methods, sampling plans, traceability needs, and the objective evidence required to provide reasonable assurance of performance.
  • Help prevent and identify counterfeit, fraudulent, and suspect items by recognizing irregularities in material certifications, test results, markings, traceability, supplier documentation, and chain of custody, and by ensuring potential concerns are controlled, evaluated, escalated, and reported.
  • Perform or support audits, surveillances, assessments, source inspections, and technical evaluations; evaluate objective evidence, document findings and observations, verify corrective action closure, and ensure quality records are complete, legible, accurate, traceable, retrievable, and maintained in approved systems.
  • Develop metrics, status reports, trend analyses, technical guidance, and training related to Code compliance, material acceptance, CMTR review, testing, supplier performance, and Certifying Engineer activities; communicate risks and recommended actions clearly to Engineering, Procurement, Quality, project leadership, suppliers, and other stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible quality engineering, materials engineering, supplier quality, inspection, testing, fabrication, or related experience in nuclear energy, Department of Energy work, ASME Code construction, or another highly regulated and technically complex environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in materials, metallurgical, mechanical, nuclear, chemical, or another relevant engineering discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, technical training, and directly applicable experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code and demonstrated ability to interpret and apply applicable material, fabrication, examination, testing, documentation, and certification requirements to procurement and supplier activities.
  • Strong working knowledge of ASME NQA-1 and/or ANSI/ANS-15.8, including procurement control, document control, item identification and control, special processes, inspection, testing, measuring and test equipment, nonconformance, corrective action, records, and audits.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing CMTRs and material certifications and evaluating chemical composition, mechanical properties, heat treatment, supplementary requirements, material identification, traceability, laboratory results, and specification compliance.
  • Experience with supplier quality oversight, material testing, welding or other special processes, inspection planning, nonconformance control, corrective action, and maintenance of complete and traceable quality records.
  • Ability to work remotely and travel to Oklo, supplier, laboratory, fabrication, and project locations as business needs require, with the communication skills and professional judgment needed to lead technical discussions and make defensible quality decisions

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience applying ASME BPVC Section II and Section III material and certification requirements, including advanced reactor or Division 5 applications, NCA-3800/NCA-3900 controls, applicable Code Cases, or related nuclear pressure-boundary requirements.
  • Experience developing or administering a Certifying Engineer, responsible engineer, technical qualification, or authorization program, including competency evaluation, training, qualification records, periodic requalification, and performance monitoring.
  • Professional Engineer licensure or an applicable certification such as ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, ASQ Certified Quality Auditor, AWS Certified Welding Inspector, NDE Level II or III, or another recognized materials, welding, inspection, or quality credential.
  • Familiarity with 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, 10 CFR Part 21, DOE Order 414.1D, commercial grade dedication, ISO/IEC 17025, ASTM material standards, suspect or counterfeit item controls, or other requirements used in nuclear procurement and fabrication.
  • Experience with electronic quality management systems, enterprise resource planning or product lifecycle management systems, material traceability databases, digital CMTR workflows, supplier portals, document control platforms, and quality metrics or data visualization.

Competencies

We are looking for a high-energy quality engineer who has a thorough understanding of:

  • ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code structure and application, including material specifications, certification, fabrication, examination, testing, documentation, Code interfaces, and the use of applicable Code Cases and referenced standards.
  • Materials engineering fundamentals, including metallurgy, product forms, manufacturing processes, heat treatment, chemical and mechanical properties, degradation mechanisms, testing methods, sampling, and acceptance criteria.
  • Certified material test report review and material traceability, including heat and lot identification, specification editions, supplementary requirements, test result evaluation, record authenticity, discrepancy resolution, and linkage of records to installed or delivered items.
  • ASME NQA-1 and ANSI/ANS-15.8 quality assurance requirements and how they are translated into practical controls for design, procurement, supplier activities, item control, special processes, inspection, testing, nonconformance, corrective action, records, and audits.
  • Procurement and supplier quality controls, including supplier qualification, purchase-order quality clauses, source surveillance, laboratory oversight, receiving inspection, material control, documentation review, supplier performance monitoring, and final data packages.
  • Special process and fabrication controls for welding, brazing, heat treatment, nondestructive examination, forming, machining, cleaning, coating, and pressure or leak testing, including procedure, personnel, equipment, and qualification requirements.
  • Technical qualification and certification programs, including competency models, independence, authority, training, examinations, authorization, requalification, performance monitoring, records, and disciplined escalation of unresolved technical issues.

  • Clear technical communication, professional challenge, sound engineering judgment, attention to detail, cross-functional collaboration, training, conflict resolution, and the ability to influence employees, suppliers, laboratories, contractors, and senior leaders.

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $150,000-$180,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Job Title: Associate Director, Field Medical Engagement Strategy & Operations- Vaccines

Sanofi's US Field Medical Vaccines team is seeking an Associate Director, Field Scientific Engagement Strategy & Operations to serve as the execution architect for our Scientific Engagement Strategy, Innovation, and Operations team. This is a leadership role for someone who doesn't just want to run a system — they want to build one that didn't exist before.

This role translates strategic vision into scalable field operating systems — turning direction set by the Director and medical leadership into the processes, tools, and infrastructure that allow Sanofi's Vaccines Field Medical team to execute with consistency, speed, and measurable impact. The AD in this role expands the organization's execution capacity, enabling the Director and leadership team to focus on strategic direction by owning the operational infrastructure that makes strategy real. This is a role for a high-performing MSL or field medical professional ready to step into a cross-functional strategic execution leadership position — without leaving the science behind.

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI-driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Strategic Execution & Field Process Integration

  • Operationalize AI and digital tools for field engagement execution — including AI-assisted engagement planning and digital-first interaction models — within the technology direction set by NA Medical leadership, serving as the field execution lead for tool adoption and integration

  • Act as the Medical lead for planning of cross-functional field execution meetings — including Plan of Action (POA) and Train the Trainer events — shaping agenda, driving operational alignment, and elevating the quality of matrix ways of working as the operational lead

Congress Execution & Operational Coordination

  • Serve as the field operational execution lead for Sanofi's annual congress calendar — coordinating with Strategic Planners, franchise leads, OBM, FBM, and Global teams to ensure timely planning and flawless on-the-ground execution within the strategic framework set by the Director and Medical Strategy Lead

  • Pilot new field congress execution approaches and engagement tactics — including digital-first interactions and innovative scientific programming formats — within the strategic framework set by leadership, and document outcomes for continuous improvement

  • Drive continuous process improvement across congress operations, including evaluation of external vendors and operational tools in partnership with the Medical Operations Manager

  • Track and report congress execution effectiveness using established operational metrics, providing field-level execution data to inform the Director's strategic decisions about congress investment and presence

Continuous Improvement & Innovation Piloting

  • Maintain and refine continuous improvement feedback loops specific to field execution processes — capturing what works, what doesn't, and why, and embedding those lessons into field team operations in alignment with the broader continuous improvement framework set by NA Medical leadership

  • Identify and pilot field execution best practices — drawing on benchmarks from leading field medical organizations — to strengthen Sanofi's engagement operations and position the team at the frontier of what Medical Affairs can be

  • Create and maintain a field execution innovation tracker — monitoring emerging engagement models, congress formats, and operational tools, and surfacing relevant opportunities to the Director and NA Medical leadership for roadmap consideration

  • Identify and eliminate process fragmentation, redundancy, and rework across field execution workflows — translating operational efficiency into measurable strategic capacity

Strategic Partnership & Insight

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Director of Field Medical Operations and Medical Strategy — bringing forward-looking operational recommendations, emerging field execution trends, and proactive risk identification that enable the Director to lead strategically

  • Develop progress reports on field execution performance for the Director, supporting the NA Strategy, Innovation, and Performance Head reporting cadence to NA Medical leadership with clear, insight-driven narratives on execution quality, process adoption, and operational outcomes

  • Surface actionable field-level insights — including post-interaction performance patterns and next best actions for high-priority external interactions — to inform leadership decision-making

About You:

We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Grüns is looking for a Chief Product Officer to lead the incredible team that brings new products, flavors, and formulations to market and to define the next chapter of what we build. Reporting to our CEO and overseeing the R&D, Science & Regulatory, and Product Development functions, you'll be the driving force behind what Grüns brings to market next.

We’re looking for a true builder – someone who knows this world deeply enough to get into the weeds with the team as needed, but is focused on building for the future, creating and scaling systems, and multiplying impact by consistently leading our high-performing team to be the best in their respective functions.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing offsites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead a best-in-class product team, ensuring each function delivers the highest-quality work and outcomes. Set a clear vision for what great looks like and ensure the team works seamlessly together to deliver.
  • Drive innovation strategy through the right product innovation roadmap, identifying emerging categories, ingredients, and consumer opportunities. Champion bold, evidence-backed innovation while building the right process to bring ideas to market efficiently through our in-house R&D capabilities
  • Create industry-leading, science-backed formulations by ensuring everything we create is efficacious, compliant, and defensible. Set the bar for how we use clinical evidence, ingredient science, and regulatory strategy as a competitive advantage.
  • Partner cross-functionally to deliver winning go-to-market strategies that translate product innovation into business results. Bring a commercial lens to every launch decision.
  • Build for quality and scale by ensuring that quality, consistency, supply chain resilience, and process efficiency are core to how we develop and launch products.

We're looking for someone who:

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in product, with at least 5+ years leading a product or R&D organization in supplements, functional food, or adjacent CPG categories
  • Proven track record of launching and scaling successful consumer products from concept through commercialization
  • Deep fluency in formulation science, ingredient sourcing, and regulatory affairs in the supplement or food space
  • Experience building and leading cross-functional product teams across R&D, development, science, and quality
  • Strong commercial instincts; knows how to connect product decisions to brand, growth, and margin outcomes

Approach to the role:

  • You thrive in a fast-moving, resource-efficient environment where speed and creativity matter as much as rigor
  • You build systems, not just solutions. When something breaks, you fix it and solve at the root by working on the thing that keeps it from breaking again
  • You measure excellence in the impact your team delivers to the business vs. in busyness or tasks completed
  • You strive to be the best at what you do and encourage your team to do the same – you’re not satisfied with good or solid, and consistently strive for excellence
  • You’re leveraging AI in unique ways to augment or accelerate quality of formulations and speed to market

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!
