Role Title: Director, People Analytics and Insights

Reports To: SVP, People

Priority Application Date: Monday, Aug 10, 2026 at 11:59PM ET.

Location: Remote

WHAT YOU’LL DO

At Teach For America, we are inspired by a single mission: one day, all children will have access to an excellent education. Achieving this mission requires that we have the talent, leadership, and systems needed to support our staff and drive impact in communities across the country.

As the Director, People Analytics and Insights, you will lead the strategies, systems, and storytelling that help TFA better understand our workforce, strengthen staff experience, and make more evidence-based talent decisions. You will transform complex workforce data into actionable insights that help leaders understand trends, evaluate the effectiveness of talent strategies and practices, identify opportunities, and make decisions that improve staff experience and organizational health.

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on analytics leader who combines analytical and technical expertise with systems thinking, strong judgement, and compelling storytelling. The ideal candidate can move fluidly between building analytical solutions, informing TFA-wide talent systems, and establishing the data practices and capabilities needed to advance TFA’s People priorities.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Reporting to the SVP, People, the Director, People Analytics & Insights will lead TFA’s people analytics strategy. The Director will establish clear strategies and priorities, manage complex cross-functional initiatives, and build the systems and organizational capabilities needed to support stronger talent decisions.

Key responsibilities include:

Lead people analytics strategy and measure talent outcomes (30%)

  • Define and execute a People Analytics strategy and roadmap aligned with People Team priorities and organizational goals.

  • Establish meaningful measures for understanding workforce trends, staff experience, engagement, performance, retention, representation, mobility, and organizational health.

  • Partner with People Team leaders and organizational stakeholders to identify key talent questions, determine appropriate analytical approaches, and translate findings into recommendations.

  • Establish an intake and prioritization approach for analytics requests, balancing recurring organizational needs with emerging questions and longer-term capability building.

Translate data into actionable talent decisions (25%)

  • Analyze workforce data and synthesize findings into clear recommendations for People Team leaders, executives, and cross-functional partners.

  • Design, administer, and analyze staff surveys and other data collection methods including engagement, pulse, and employee-lifecycle listening.

  • Partner with People Team, Technology & Data, Finance, and business leaders to identify opportunities, risks, and trends related to workforce planning, talent investments, performance, and retention.

Build reporting, analytics and data governance capabilities (25%)

  • Develop and continuously improve scalable dashboards, reporting tools, and analytics solutions that enable stakeholders to access and understand People insights.

  • Establish and refine data governance practices that ensure People data is accurate, accessible, ethical, and aligned with organizational standards.

  • Assess existing data sources, systems, and reporting practices to identify gaps, and recommend improvements to TFA’s people analytics infrastructure.

  • Partner with technology and data teams and broader TFA data communities to align data architecture, governance, and practices..

Advance a culture of data-informed decision making (20%)

  • Build data fluency across the People Team and broader organization by creating tools, resources, and guidance that help leaders interpret and apply insights.

  • Translate technical findings into clear visualizations, summaries, presentations, and actionable recommendations for technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • Develop compelling narratives and presentations that tell the story behind the data and help stakeholders understand the staff experience.

  • Stay current on emerging practices in people analytics,, staff listening, AI, and automation to assess their responsible application at TFA.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

  • 4+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, people analytics, workforce analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

  • Demonstrated experience developing or implementing people analytics strategies, operating practices, or organizational reporting solutions.

  • Experience analyzing workforce or staff data and translating findings into actionable recommendations that inform talent and organizational decisions.

  • Experience designing, administering, and analyzing staff surveys or other forms of organizational research.

  • Experience developing reports and dashboards using business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar).

  • Proficiency with SQL, including experience querying and combining data from relational databases or analytical data models.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including analyzing data and developing executive-ready materials.

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to integrate multiple data sources, identify meaningful patterns, test assumptions, and distinguish evidence from interpretation.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and navigate ambiguity effectively.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated success building trust, influencing decisions, and creating alignment across stakeholder groups and varying levels of leadership.

  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand the connections across the employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, onboarding, engagement performance, development, and retention.

  • A demonstrated commitment to equity and the ability to examine how talent practices and outcomes may vary across demographic groups, roles, levels, teams, and organizational contexts.

Preferred:

  • Experience with People Analytics or HR data within a People/HR function.

  • Experience with Workday or another Human Resources Information System (HRIS) reporting tools.

  • Experience with staff-listening platforms such as Culture Amp or similar systems.

  • Experience establishing data governance frameworks, metric frameworks, data quality standards, and operational practices.

  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools and automation to improve analytics workflows, reporting, and operational efficiency while applying safeguards..

YOUR FUTURE TEAM

The People Team enables TFA’s mission by ensuring the organization has the talent, leadership, and systems needed to deliver sustained impact. We steward talent across the full lifecycle and build the people infrastructure that supports, develops, and deploys staff to drive strong outcomes for students and communities.

The Director, People Analytics & Insights will play a critical role in strengthening how TFA understands its workforce, evaluates the effectiveness of its talent strategies and practices, and uses evidence to shape talent strategy and decisions.

This role will partner closely with People Team functions, Technology & Data teams, Finance, and leaders across the organization to ensure data is leveraged as a strategic asset in attracting, developing, and retaining talent.

YOUR COMPENSATION

TIer A: $74,300 - $97,500

jobs.title: Native Ads für Performance Marketing im E‑Commerce (m/w/d) · Remote
jobs.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei unsBei deinem wöchentlichen Accountdeepdive auf Outbrain fällt dir auf, dass einer der Accounts bei 7.
jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Bei deinem wöchentlichen Accountdeepdive auf Outbrain fällt dir auf, dass einer der Accounts bei 7.000 € Tagesbudget aktuell stagniert.

Du gehst auf Kontoebene rein. Die Anzeigen liefern konstante Werte, Funnel-CTR ist stabil, die Offerpage bricht ein. Zwei Advertorial-Angles tragen den ganzen Account, der Rest ist die letzten Tage unter der Zielperformance. Du entscheidest: Bedarf an neuen Advertorialfunnels, um über andere Problemangles neue Kunden zu erreichen.

Du gehst mit dem Copywriting- und Creative-Team in den Austausch. Nicht mit einer Idee, sondern mit Daten und einer Hypothese.

Am Freitag sitzt du im Call mit der Geschäftsführung des Kunden. Sie will Budget auf Meta verschieben. Du rechnest gegen: Deckungsbeitrag pro Kanal, CAC, Wachstumskurve der letzten sechs Monate. Das Budget bleibt bei Native, weil das ganzheitlich die beste Entscheidung für den Kunden ist. Der Kunde ist happy.

In den Wochen darauf starten die neuen Kampagnen und die Performance zieht wieder an.

Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.

Wir denken Native Ads anders

Für die meisten Agenturen ist Native Advertising über Taboola und Outbrain ein Restbudget-Kanal. Etwas, das man testet, wenn Meta und Google ausgereizt sind. Wir behandeln Native als eigenen Wachstumskanal mit eigener Logik.

Denn Native gewinnt man nicht allein im Werbekonto, sondern genauso auf der Strecke von der Anzeige bis zur Offerpage. Wer nur Kampagnen steuert, sieht die Hälfte des Hebels nicht.

  • Erstklassiges Media Buying und exzellente Funnel-Architektur als Kern der Arbeit: Advertorials, Pre-Lander und Offerpages werden getestet wie Ads. Für die schnelle Umsetzung hast du ein Team und Prozesse an der Hand

  • Steuerung auf POAS und Deckungsbeitrag statt auf Klickpreise, die über Profitabilität nichts sagen

  • Systematische Angle-Tests statt Einzeltreffer, damit ein Winner-Angle über mehrere Kampagnen skaliert wird.

Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst nicht ein paar Native-Accounts. Du übernimmst die profitable Skalierung unserer Kunden. Wie sie über Native Ads wachsen, entscheidest du.

Denn wir werden nicht dafür bezahlt, Kampagnen zu verwalten. Wir werden dafür bezahlt, dass unsere Kunden profitabel wachsen. Das gilt für dein Team genauso wie für dich.

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du verantwortest das gesamte Native-Adspend-Volumen der Agentur und entwickelst die Native-Strategie weiter. Welche Skalierungsstrategien, Funnel-Typen und welche Brands zu uns passen, entscheidest du.

  • Du führst perspektivisch ein Team aus Media Buyern, Copywritern und Creative-Strategen fachlich. Du gibst Feedback auf Kampagnen, Funnel und Creatives.

  • Du baust das Team bei Wachstum aus und führst neue Leute ein. Die Projektverteilung und die Wochenendbereitschaft verantwortest du, organisiert wird sie im Team.

  • Du verantwortest selbst die anspruchsvollsten Native-Accounts, inklusive Strategie und Steuerung. Führung heißt hier nicht, das Handwerk abzugeben.

  • Du führst die Kundenreportings und sorgst für eine lange partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit.

  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kunden weiter und skalierst ihre Budgets. Der größte Hebel liegt in den Accounts, die schon laufen.

  • Du verantwortest die Funnel-Architektur von der Anzeige bis zur Offerpage. Du briefst Copywriting und Grafik und bewertest die Ergebnisse gegen die Performance-Daten.

  • Du standardisierst Onboarding, Kampagnen-Setup und Reporting im Native-Bereich. Du dokumentierst Learnings so, dass dein Team sie ohne dich anwendet.

Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Was du herausfindest, bleibt nicht in deinem Account. Es wird Teil der Methodik, mit der das ganze Native-Team arbeitet.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du hast bereits über Taboola oder Outbrain Accounts mit über 100.000 € monatlichen Adpsend selbst verantwortet. Alternativ Track-Record bei META.

  • Du liebst Media Buying und dir fällt es leicht, Accounts in kurzer Zeit profitabel zu skalieren und bei einbrechender Performance auch harte Budget-Cutting durchzuführen.

  • Du hast das Know-how, die komplette Funnel-Strecke von der Anzeige bis zur Offerpage zu durchdenken und zu optimieren. Das schließt Advertorial- und Pre-Lander-Mechanik ein.

  • Du rechnest Budgetentscheidungen gegen Marge, CAC und Deckungsbeitrag, nicht gegen Umsatz. Deine Erfahrung kommt von D2C-Kunden oder einem eigenen Shop.

  • Du hast idealerweise schon erste Erfahrung in der Teamführung mit Feedbackgesprächen und Leistungsbewertung.

  • Du bringst idealerweise Tracking-Wissen mit. Mit Tools wie Voluum oder Attributionslösungen wie Hyros, admetrics oder Tracify hast du schon gearbeitet.

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn du noch keine mehrjährige Erfahrung im Media Buying hast. Diese Rolle steuert sechsstellige Monatsbudgets und führt perspektivisch ein Team ganzes. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus.

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Du übernimmst die ersten anspruchsvollen Native-Accounts und lernst dein Team kennen. Du siehst, wo Prozesse stehen und wo sie fehlen.

Mittelfristig. Du verantwortest die Entwicklung von Native Ads als eine unserer Kern-Agenturdienstleistungen. Testing, Kampagnensteuerung und Skalierung laufen nach Standards, die du weiterentwickelt hast.

Langfristig. Du baust den Bereich aus: mehr Accounts, größere Adspend-Budgets, mehr Leute und Prozesse im Team. Daneben steht die Fachlaufbahn als Spezialist für Funnel und Angles. Beide Wege entstehen durch Ergebnisse und nicht durch Wartezeit.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

If you’ve ever thought:

jobs.excerpt: In 1933, Harry Beck redesigned the London Underground map.
jobs.description:
In 1933, Harry Beck redesigned the London Underground map. Instead of preserving geography, he redesigned it around how people actually navigated the system. The result became one of the most influential examples of information design ever created.

Beck understood that people don't need a perfect representation of complexity. They just need a system that helps them accomplish what they came to do. We think accounting deserves the same kind of clarity and simplification.

Today, people bounce between their bank*, accounting software, spreadsheets, receipts, and disconnected workflows just to prepare transactions for their books. We think that’s backwards.

At Mercury, we're building toward a future where accounting becomes increasingly automatic, intelligent, and deeply integrated into how businesses operate. Instead of asking customers to adapt to accounting software, we want software that adapts to the way customers already work.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Accounting Integrations team and help imagine what that future looks like. This is an opportunity to redefine how businesses experience accounting.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the design vision for Mercury's Accounting Integrations experience, from early product strategy through polished execution
  • Reimagine how customers prepare and complete accounting work in Mercury through thoughtful automation and new interaction models, shaping how customers interact with one of our most strategically important product areas
  • Translate complex accounting workflows into intuitive product experiences that make financial operations feel simple
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Research to shape the future of accounting at Mercury through rapid exploration, experimentation, and thoughtful product strategy
  • Define shared interaction patterns and visual language across Mercury's accounting ecosystem
  • Raise the quality bar for accounting experiences across Mercury through exceptional craft and design leadership

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years of experience leading complex, end-to-end product design initiatives
  • Thinks in systems and workflows, not just individual screens
  • Learns new domains obsessively until they can challenge experts on their own assumptions
  • Brings clarity to ambiguous problems and helps teams align around a compelling direction
  • Experience turning highly complex workflows into simple, intuitive product experiences
  • Balances automation with transparency, trust, and user control
  • Brings strong product judgment, clear communication, and a high degree of ownership
  • Uses AI to accelerate exploration and deepen their thinking without compromising craft

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits. Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following:

jobs.title: Manager, Emergency Cash Recipient Experience
jobs.excerpt: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011.
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this role

GiveDirectly is scaling our emergency response operations to reach more people, faster, with cash after a crisis. Our belief is that cash assistance, delivered quickly after a crisis, is more effective and dignified than in-kind assistance for most populations in crisis. As our programs grow in size and complexity, so does the importance of ensuring every recipient receives timely, accurate, and compassionate support whenever they engage with GiveDirectly.

As Manager, Emergency Cash Recipient Experience, you will own the recipient support experience across Emergency Cash programs. You will design and operate the systems, processes, people, and technology that ensure recipients can easily access help, receive high-quality support, and have confidence in GiveDirectly throughout their journey.

You will lead GiveDirectly's Emergency Cash call center function, overseeing everything from onboarding and training to operational deployment during live responses. You will monitor recipient interactions across channels to identify opportunities for improvement, resolve systemic issues, and ensure consistently high service quality. You will also own the long tail of recipient cases after a response launches, allowing Response Team Leads to focus on program delivery while ensuring no recipient issue falls through the cracks.

Looking ahead, you will help shape the future of recipient support by partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build technology that improves recipient experience. As GiveDirectly introduces AI-powered recipient support, you will oversee the performance, quality, and continuous improvement of those systems to ensure they meet the same high standards as our human support teams.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building operational systems, leading customer support teams, using data to improve service quality, and leveraging technology to create exceptional recipient experiences at scale.

Reports to: Director, Emergency Cash Delivery

Level: Manager, Emergency Cash Recipient Experience

Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel up to 30% of the time, including approximately 1–2 team retreats per year.

What you'll do

Recipient Support Operations

  • Own GiveDirectly's Emergency Cash recipient support function across all communication channels, ensuring recipients receive timely, accurate, and empathetic assistance throughout every response.
  • Build and maintain standardized operating procedures, training materials, quality standards, and operational playbooks that enable consistent recipient support across programs.
  • Plan and deploy call center capacity for each Emergency Cash response, ensuring staffing, training, and operational readiness meet response needs.
  • Recruit, onboard, train, and continuously improve call center personnel and partner organizations delivering recipient support.
  • Directly coach and provide real-time quality feedback to call center agents on live tickets and calls, correcting workflow and data-handling errors as they happen.

Recipient Experience & Quality

  • Monitor recipient interactions to catch quality issues early and ensure consistently high-quality service, identify emerging issues, and improve the overall recipient experience.
  • Establish quality assurance processes, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide visibility into recipient satisfaction, operational performance, and systemic trends.
  • Analyze recipient feedback and support data to identify opportunities for product, operational, and policy improvements across Emergency Cash.
  • Champion recipient-centered service standards across Emergency Cash, ensuring recipient experience remains central to operational decision-making.
  • Define and enforce ticket workflow rules and SLAs (assignment ownership, escalation tagging, response timeframes) that keep the queue moving and prevent cases from stalling.

Response Support

  • Own the long tail of recipient support cases following program launch, resolving escalations and complex recipient issues on behalf of Response Leads.
  • Coordinate across Product, Delivery, Payments, and Engineering teams to ensure recipient issues are resolved quickly and systemic problems are addressed.
  • Manage the roster of consultants used for surge capacity specifically for recipient-facing activities.
  • Develop scalable processes for handling exceptions, appeals, payment issues, and other complex recipient cases while maintaining a positive recipient experience.

Recipient Experience Technology

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and improve the technology supporting recipient engagement, case management, and support workflows.
  • Lead the operational rollout of new recipient support technologies, ensuring they improve both recipient outcomes and operational efficiency. Improved recipient outcomes could include, but are not limited to, systems related to enrollment, data protection, and payments.
  • Oversee the deployment, supervision, and continuous improvement of AI-powered recipient support agents, ensuring responses remain accurate, empathetic, safe, and aligned with GiveDirectly policies.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support work while maintaining high-quality recipient experiences through thoughtful human oversight.

Qualifications

Required

  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly's values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity.
  • 3–5 years of experience leading customer support, contact center operations, service delivery, recipient support, customer success, operations, or similar functions.
  • Demonstrated experience building operational systems, procedures, and quality assurance processes.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for delivering high-quality recipient or customer support at scale.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.
  • Excellent project management skills and ability to independently lead cross-functional initiatives.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments while balancing operational excellence with recipient empathy.
  • Demonstrated experience improving customer or recipient experience through process design and technology.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting humanitarian response, international development, or social impact programs.
  • Experience managing outsourced or distributed contact center operations.
  • Experience implementing or managing CRM, ticketing, or case management platforms.
  • Experience working with AI-powered customer support tools, chatbots, or conversational AI systems.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to improve customer-facing technology.
  • Experience designing quality assurance frameworks, service metrics, and customer satisfaction measurement systems.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third-party salary aggregator to ensure that staff's total compensation package (base compensation + bonus) falls within the 75th percentile of similar roles, at similar organizations. We also have a no-negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

United States

  • Base Salary: $94,700
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$9,470, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be $11,080 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $104,170+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK, or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Working at GiveDirectly

Commitment to Safeguarding

jobs.description:
Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for high-ownership generalists to join the Founder's Office for BJAK's finance super app expansion. This role is for builders who can take on ambiguous business problems, move fast across functions and help launch new financial products, markets, licences and partnerships.


What You'll Own

  • Drive zero-to-one strategic projects for the finance super app.

  • Support licensing, market entry, partner acquisition, office setup, hiring and operating plans.

  • Research markets, competitors, regulations, partners and business models.

  • Turn founder-level ideas into structured plans, owners, timelines and next actions.

  • Work across product, legal, compliance, finance, hiring, operations and country teams.

  • Build trackers, briefs, memos, operating documents and execution rhythms.

  • Own urgent business problems until they are solved.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong generalist with high ownership, strong writing and sharp business judgement.

  • Able to learn new industries, regulations and markets quickly.

  • Comfortable working on licensing, partnerships, operations, market research and execution.

  • Can turn messy inputs into clear plans and follow-through.

  • Fast, resourceful and calm under pressure.

  • Strong English communication and structured thinking.

  • Experience in startups, consulting, fintech, strategy, operations, investing or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Finds a way without waiting for a full playbook.

  • Can work with senior leaders and still do hands-on execution.

  • Writes clearly, thinks practically and follows up relentlessly. Handles ambiguity without creating drama.

  • Cares about real outcomes, not looking important.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want strategy decks.

  • Candidates who need fixed job scope and predictable tasks.

  • People who want title/status more than responsibility.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: About KestraKestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.
jobs.description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

The Role

We're looking for a pragmatic Product Manager to lead Kestra's product in the data orchestration domain: how data teams build, run, and monitor pipelines with Kestra, from ingestion and transformation to data-aware orchestration across the tools they already use. You'll take features from customer problem to delivery with minimal process. This is not a "project manager" or "product owner" role; we care about releasing real value fast and won't ask you to maintain SCRUM rituals.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full product lifecycle - understand the problems of data engineers, analytics engineers, and data platform teams; define technical specs; prototype (AI tools encouraged); and work closely with developers to deliver high-quality releases.

  • Shape Kestra's data-aware orchestration - pipelines modeled around the datasets they produce, with lineage, freshness, and data quality treated as part of orchestration.

  • Deepen integrations with the modern data stack - dbt, Fivetran, Airbyte, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Kafka, and the wider Kestra plugin ecosystem.

  • Make migrations easy - clear paths and documentation for teams moving to Kestra from Airflow and similar orchestrators.

  • Collaborate with the Product Lead and CTO to shape and scope features for each 8-week release cycle.

  • Make informed tradeoffs, balancing simplicity, technical feasibility, and long-term sustainability.

  • Coordinate development progress and ensure features are delivered, QA'd, documented, and ready to go.

  • Improve the product continuously based on customer feedback, usage data, and community input.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on, startup-minded PM comfortable working without heavy process or structure.

  • Strong background in the data domain - you've built or managed data pipelines yourself and know tools like dbt, Fivetran or Airbyte, and warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks from hands-on use.

  • Practical experience with workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Kestra itself) and a clear understanding of scheduling, backfills, retries, and dependencies between datasets.

  • Excellent communication and clarity in writing - specs, product decisions, and public-facing documentation.

  • Full ownership mentality. You iterate quickly based on feedback and don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Experience or familiarity with open-source development - comfortable writing publicly and discussing product changes in GitHub repositories.

  • Comfortable working with globally distributed teams across time zones.

Bonus Points

  • Past experience as a data engineer or analytics engineer.

  • Experience moving a team from Airflow (or another orchestrator) to a new platform.

  • Experience in a B2B software or open-source company.

  • Exposure to SaaS products, especially self-serve or platform-oriented.

  • Familiarity with data engineering communities and how they adopt tools.

What You Get

  • Real ownership in a globally distributed, technical team.

  • Direct exposure to product strategy and company priorities.

  • A product running mission-critical workloads in production at over 10,000 organizations.

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and health insurance.

Spyre's pipeline includes investigational extended half-life antibodies targeting α4β7, TL1A, and IL-23.

As Associate Director, Medical Writer, you will lead or make key contributions to clinical and regulatory documents within our organization. You will be responsible for medical writing strategy and timely deliverables for one or more projects, submissions or programs. You may be responsible for oversight of medical writing consultants or other writers on complex, high-stakes documents or submissions.

You will collaborate with cross-functional subject matter experts (SMEs) to meet aggressive timelines. You will project manage high-quality documents and/or submissions from start to finish, develop strong relationships, and be an advocate for best practices in Medical Writing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Medical Writing contact for projects, submissions, or programs. Collaborate with manager and with other functions on planning and appropriate resourcing.
  • Provide strategic input to program team(s), ensuring business goals and regulatory needs are met.
  • Lead the medical writing planning and deliverables for INDs, CTAs, BLAs, or MAAs.
  • Develop timelines in collaboration with our team. Plan for any required data with SMEs.
  • Author key clinical, nonclinical and regulatory documents, including but not limited to clinical study protocols, amendments, IBs, CSRs, data summaries, CTD summaries, briefing books and regulatory responses.
    • Interpret and explain data in a manner consistent with the audience. Ensure required elements are clearly described and documents comply with ethical and regulatory standards.
    • Manage review cycles; collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to address comments.
    • Coordinate QC, finalization and publication of documents.
    • Review or contribute to supporting study documents, including but not limited to informed consent forms, study charters, or pharmacy manuals, if required.
    • Ensure key messages are clear and consistent across and within documents.
  • Provide status updates to keep teams, the department, and leadership informed.
  • Identify risks and contribute to risk mitigation or contingency planning for submission activities.
  • Proactively contribute to process improvements and standards across the team. Develop or maintain document templates, job aids, tools, and training materials.
  • Advocate across cross-functional teams to implement industry best practices such as lean authoring and strategic review.

Ideal Candidate:

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline, preferably in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or related field. Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MD, PharmD) is a plus.
  • A minimum of 8+ years of experience in regulatory medical writing is required.
  • Proven track record of successfully leading complex or high-stakes submissions.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines simultaneously.
  • Proven track record of authoring high-quality clinical and regulatory documents, including for complex document types.
  • Strong knowledge of global pharmaceutical regulations and guidelines, including FDA, EMA, and ICH requirements.
  • Excellent leadership, collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills (taking initiative, problem solving, conflict resolution, change management, strategic thinking).
  • Ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Expert in word processing software (e.g., Office) and document management systems (e.g., Veeva).

What We Offer:

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where you help shape the culture of our young company, contribute broadly to advance meaningful medicines, and learn quickly.
  • Market competitive compensation and benefits package, including base salary, performance bonus, equity grant opportunities, health, welfare & retirement benefits.
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Two, one-week company-wide shutdowns each
  • Commitment to provide professional development opportunities.
  • Remote working environment with frequent in-person meetings to address complex problems and build relationships.

The expected salary range offer for this role is $170,000 to $199,000. Actual pay offered may vary depending on job related knowledge, experience, education, and geographic location.

jobs.excerpt: What We Can Achieve Together:The Business Development Specialist, Asia Pacific plays a central role in advancing The Nature Conservancy’s public funding and external engagement priorities across the region.
jobs.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:

The Business Development Specialist, Asia Pacific plays a central role in advancing The Nature Conservancy’s public funding and external engagement priorities across the region. Reporting to the Director of External Affairs, Asia Pacific, and working closely with the Proposal Development Manager, this role contributes to the development, management, and delivery of the public funding pipeline, from opportunity identification through to proposal submission. Working closely with regional and global teams, the Specialist drives the design and preparation of competitive public funding proposals, ensuring alignment with conservation priorities, donor requirements, and organisational strategies. The role engages across Business Units, thematic teams, and enabling functions to identify, design, track and translate public funding opportunities into high-quality submissions. This position contributes to strengthening Asia Pacific’s public funding capability and supports delivery of the One Conservancy Public Funding Strategy and TNC’s 2030 Goals.

This role is a two‑year fixed‑term position with the possibility of extension, subject to work performance, business needs, and funding availability.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The Business Development Specialist plays a foundational role in enabling the success of public funding efforts across Asia Pacific. The role is responsible for leading key aspects of the public funding lifecycle including opportunity identification, concept development, and proposal development. The role coordinates multi-disciplinary teams, establishes timelines and workplans, and ensures proposal components are developed to a high standard and within required deadlines. The Specialist develops and refines proposal content, including drafting and editing technical narratives, logical frameworks, theories of change, and supporting materials. They ensure proposals are clear, compelling, and responsive to donor expectations, while maintaining consistency with TNC’s priorities. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, sound judgement, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. It also involves contributing to the continuous improvement of processes, tools, and approaches that support public funding success across the region.

Public Funding Pipeline & Opportunity Support

  • Lead the early identification, screening, and tracking of Calls for Proposals (CFPs) relevant to Asia Pacific priorities.
  • Drive the filtering and prioritization of funding opportunities, aligned with regional strategies and conservation priorities.
  • Develops early-stage write-ups of priority conservation projects for opportunity search, positioning, and internal evaluation.
  • Maintains visibility of funding opportunities, timelines, and pipeline progression across the region.
  • Participate on internal selection panels, leading the prioritisation of selected proposals

Proposal Development & Grant Writing Support

  • Develops public funding proposals, including drafting, editing, and integrating contributions from multiple stakeholders
  • Oversee assembly of proposal components (background materials, annexes, donor templates, supporting documentation and compliance elements).
  • Prepares concept notes, expressions of interest, and full proposals.
  • Ensures that proposals are consistent, high quality, and aligned with donor requirements.

Capacity Building & Internal Support

  • Contributes to strengthening public funding capability across Asia Pacific through guidance, tools, and training
  • Promotes consistent approaches, templates, and quality standards for proposal development
  • Shares insights and lessons learned to improve effectiveness and outcomes

Reporting & Operational Support

  • Support regional public funding reporting, including pipeline and performance, progress, reporting and status.
  • Maintain and update entries in BBCRM for the AP public Funding pipeline
  • Support preparation of internal updates, summaries, and briefings for regional and global stakeholders.
  • Assist in monitoring and updating team tools, templates, and reporting systems

Team & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Supports effective collaboration across country, regional, and global teams involved in public funding proposal development.
  • Assist in facilitating information flow between Business Units, thematic teams, and enabling functions (finance, grants, legal, communications) to develop proposals.
  • Facilitates alignment between conservation priorities and funding opportunities.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Contributes to multiple concurrent proposal development processes and early-stage project development activities.
  • Works under guidance of senior staff but demonstrates initiative and strong organizational skills.
  • Applies judgement in managing priorities, timelines, and stakeholder engagement across proposals
  • Works closely with Business Unit leaders, thematic and conservation strategy leads, and cross-functional teams such as finance, grants, legal and communication teams across the Asia Pacific.
  • Contributes to strengthening public funding pipeline quality, visibility, and coordination across the region.
  • Ensures accuracy, timeliness, and consistency in systems, reporting, and documentation.
  • Provides proposal writing training to staff as needed.
  • Undertake international travel within Asia Pacific and globally, as required.
  • May supervise administrative staff and/or volunteers, interns, or temporary staff.
  • Serve as a team leader for assigned projects and coordinate the work of others.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree and 4 years related experience or equivalent combination.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Experience presenting to and/or communicating with business, government or legislative staff and/or program leadership.
  • Experience in designing, implementing and directing multiple complex projects and ensuring program accountability.
  • Communications experience including preparing and presenting project proposals and developing written communications.
  • Experience working with corporate or NGO partners, and government agencies.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with public funding mechanisms and funder processes (e.g. bilateral/multilateral funders)
  • Experience in supporting project design, concept development and proposal packaging including experience in developing theories of transformational change, result chains and related methodologies.
  • Understanding of conservation, climate or sustainable development issues in Asia Pacific.
  • Multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience preferred.
  • Experience writing successful public funding proposals.
  • Experience coordinating with people in difference locations and cultures.
  • Ability to work effectively in informal or horizontal teams and collaborate cross function and countries in a global organization.
  • Knowledge and application of current and evolving trends in public funding.
  • Experience researching information from divergent sources and compiling it into a cohesive reporting structure.

Pay Grade : 7

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to become the single owner of our B2B platform — its reliability, its commercial performance, and its evolution.

This is not a feature-factory PM role. The platform is mature, revenue-generating, and deeply integrated with external partners. Your job is to understand it end to end, find what causes the most damage or blocks the biggest opportunity, and drive the right improvements to completion — from stability and technical debt to unlocking revenue hidden in existing integrations and partner capabilities.

If you enjoy untangling complex systems, working shoulder to shoulder with engineers, and having a mandate broad enough to shape both the technical and business direction of a product, this role will fit you well.

Our platform helps hotels expand their distribution, reach new guest segments, and access sales channels that are not typically available through traditional hotel systems. We build technology that connects hospitality businesses with major travel platforms and enables them to manage these opportunities efficiently at scale.As an Official AirBnB partner, we work closely with one of the world's leading travel marketplaces while continuing to develop new integrations, automation, and distribution solutions for hotels.

What You'll Do

Keep the platform healthy:

  • Analyze production incidents, support cases, system metrics, and business data to find recurring, high-impact problems — and eliminate their root causes, not their symptoms.
  • Identify technical weaknesses, operational inefficiencies, and accumulated product or technical debt, and quantify their real cost.
  • Establish a clear, lightweight process for identifying, tracking, prioritizing, and resolving platform issues.

Grow what the platform delivers:

  • Review existing partner integrations and surface missed capabilities, underused features, and new connection opportunities.
  • Recognize opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction that are hidden in existing systems and previously postponed initiatives.

Own the direction:

  • Build and maintain a transparent roadmap balancing reliability, technical investment, and business opportunities.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly based on impact, urgency, engineering effort, and long-term value.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Support, Operations, Sales, Leadership, and external partners.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

The primary profile: a technically strong product thinker — someone who can read logs, dashboards, and SQL results as comfortably as a P&L conversation, and who treats an existing system as a source of opportunity rather than a obstacles.

Experience

  • 5+ years in Product Management, Technical Product Management, or Engineering Management, with a track record of end-to-end ownership.
  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS platforms, marketplaces, or integration-heavy systems.
  • Experience taking on ambiguous problems without a predefined backlog or established process.

Technical Background

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, integrations, databases, background processes, and distributed systems.
  • Able to investigate production issues using logs, dashboards, SQL, monitoring tools, and technical documentation.
  • Able to quickly build a mental model of a complex existing system and identify where its major risks live.
  • A prior background as a team lead, solutions architect, or engineering manager is a strong advantage.

Product and Business Thinking

  • Structured problem-solving and the ability to quantify the impact of technical and product problems.
  • Strong prioritization — keeping teams focused on what matters most, and saying no clearly.
  • Good business intuition: recognizing when a "technical" issue is actually a revenue or retention problem.
  • Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and adjusting as evidence arrives.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Hospitality Tech, Travel Tech, PMS, CRS, Channel Management, or OTA integrations.
  • Experience working with external technology partners and complex third-party integrations.
  • Experience improving operational and support processes.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered products and automation.

What Success Looks Like (first 6–12 months)

  • You understand the platform's critical business flows and its main technical and operational risks.
  • A structured process exists for identifying, evaluating, and prioritizing platform issues — and the team trusts it.
  • Recurring production and operational problems are measurably down in number and impact.
  • A transparent roadmap balances reliability and business improvements, and stakeholders know where to look.
  • You've delivered visible business impact: high-cost issues fixed, at least one previously overlooked opportunity shipped.

Why This Role Is Different — Read This Before Applying

This is not a role for someone who wants to ship a new feature every sprint. The pace of visible product change here is deliberately slower than in a growth-stage feature team — and that is by design.

What you get instead is depth and mandate: a mature, commercially important platform, real authority over its priorities, and problems that require both technical judgment and business thinking to solve. Most of the highest-impact work will be invisible to end users and very visible to the business.

If reading that made the role more attractive rather than less — you're probably the person we're looking for.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity package
  • Define a new product category through discovery before the market figures it out
  • Direct access to founders and technical leadership
  • Autonomy to experiment, take risks, and drive discovery
  • Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and a massive traditional industry

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Paid Social – Meta & TikTok (m/w/d) · Remot
jobs.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei unsMittwochmorgen.  Du öffnest den Business Manager und siehst zwei neue Hooks laufen, deutlich über Benchmark.
jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Mittwochmorgen. Du öffnest den Business Manager und siehst zwei neue Hooks laufen, deutlich über Benchmark.

Du erhöhst direkt die Budgets. Anschließend briefst du Anna, unsere Creative Strategistin, auf die Iteration der Best Performer.

Anna baut mit Alex, Mona und Tobi aus dem Creative Team ein neues Set. UGC, Founder Ads und mehrere Statics. Wenige Tage später gehen sie live.

Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance und die nächsten Schritte. Dazu deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Produktlaunch. Rabatte allein reichen dir nicht. Jede Bestellung muss einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag tragen.

Danach briefst du dein Team. Jeder Schritt der Kampagne ist klar verteilt. Am Launchtag knackst du für den Kunden 50.000 € Ad Spend an einem Tag, profitabel.

Genau das ist dein Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.

Wir denken Paid Social anders

Dass das Creative über die Performance entscheidet, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Das ist Standard. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel mit. Denn ein starker ROAS entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads. Er entsteht aus dem Angebot dahinter:

  • Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht.

  • Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Creative verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter.

  • Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer, dazu ein AI-Stack für mehr Output.

Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst nicht ein paar Werbekonten. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Wachstum deiner Kunden über Social Ads und entwickelst eigenständig die richtige Strategie.

Denn wir arbeiten nicht mit Kunden zusammen, um Kampagnen zu verwalten. Wir arbeiten mit ihnen, um sie zum Wachsen zu bringen.

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung

  • Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend.

  • Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit Anna und dem Creative Team. UGC, Founder Ads und Statics entstehen aus Testdaten, nicht aus Bauchgefühl.

  • Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien. Unser Team setzt sie um und arbeitet sie im Detail aus.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohen Ad-Spend-Leveln nicht lange.

  • Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst auf Entscheiderebene, nicht nur zum Kanal

  • Du baust den Social Ads Bereich weiter aus, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder

Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE einmal. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für das gesamte Paid Social Team übernehmen will und sich perspektivisch als Paid Social Lead entwickelt.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei

  • Nachweisbare Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets

  • Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager. Dazu Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, Admetrics oder Tracify

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeiträgen, CAC und POAS. Ohne diese Zahlen lässt sich profitabel nicht skalieren

  • Strategisches Verständnis für E-Commerce. Du denkst über den Werbekanal hinaus und steuerst Projekte entlang des gesamten Kundengeschäfts

  • Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads. Du erkennst, warum ein Creative verkauft, und nicht nur, dass es verkauft

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau für Kundenkommunikation und Copy-Bewertung. Englisch fließend für die Arbeit in den Ad-Managern

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, auch weil wir 100 % remote arbeiten

  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder im Mentoring von Junioren

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn du keine E-Commerce-Erfahrung mitbringst. Wir suchen jemanden, der Accounts auf exzellentem Niveau steuert. Fachlich challengen wir dich gern. Das E-Commerce-Know-how solltest du jedoch schon mitbringen.

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Lead deines Fachbereichs.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Einarbeitung in die EVOLVE-Methodik und unsere Prozesse. Du übernimmst erste Accounts gemeinsam mit dem Team.

Mittelfristig. Volle Verantwortung für mehrere High-Budget-Accounts. Du steuerst das Paid-Social-Team fachlich und onboardest ein weiteres Teammitglied.

Langfristig. Du führst als Paid Social Lead den gesamten Social Ads Bereich, fachlich und disziplinarisch, bis zu zehn Personen.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

The Director Site Management & Monitoring (DSMM) is accountable for delivering the committed part of all clinical interventional studies under their supervision according to agreed resources, budget and timelines complying with AZ Procedural Documents, international guidelines such as ICH-GCP as well as relevant local regulations.

The DSMM is responsible for line managing dedicated group(s) of staff and responsible for planning and utilization of staff resources, assigned budget, objective setting and performance follow-up.

jobs.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

About the role

We are seeking highly organized and customer-focused Cargo Claims Adjusters to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for speaking to customers on the phone, educating and helping the customer work through their claim to the best possible outcome. Your role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of claims, triaging critical claims, and delivering service to all constituents of the claim.

The ideal candidate has a willingness and experience to work with all parties attendant to a claim to quickly achieve optimal claim results.

Who you are

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of being part of a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate claim professional who cares about the customer and their experience.
  • Empathetic. You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with.
  • Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creative. You can find the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the insured’s best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational.
  • Curious. You have to want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and action them to a prompt resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it.
  • Communicative. (we'd love to know what this means to you)
  • And did we mention, you have a sense of humor. Claims are hard enough as it is.

What you'll do

  • Provide prompt, courteous and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by responding to customer inquiries, initiating investigations and resolving customer claims.
  • Gather necessary information from customers to initiate the claim and explain policy, coverage, and appropriate course of action
  • Manage an inventory of claims, establish initial reserves for all potential exposures, and adjust as appropriate throughout the claim
  • Coordinate the repair of damaged vehicles and assist with rental reimbursement
  • Recognize recovery opportunities in regards to subrogation and salvage, as well as total loss
  • Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures
  • Communicate with involved parties and negotiate appropriate settlements with claimants, insureds, and attorneys within approved payment authority
  • Provide input for continuous development of claims guidelines, best practices, and process improvements
  • Oversee and direct outside investigative service providers and work closely with the client and client counsel and investigative services to resolve the claim
  • Engage in learning opportunities to build knowledge of personal lines claims, court decisions impacting the claims function, current guidelines in claims function, and policy changes and modifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in commercial cargo claims, ideally tractor trailer, and some dealings with Third-Party PD/Total Loss
  • Active adjuster license required: resident state license if available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license
  • Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures
  • Commercial experience necessary
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate claims data and make sound decisions based on established guidelines, policies, and procedures
  • Curious and motivated by problem solving and questioning the status quo
  • Desire to engage in learning opportunities and continuous professional development

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Marketing Manager Growth Marketing für E-Commerce Agentur (m/w/d) · Remote
jobs.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei unsDu entwickelst einen Lead-Magnet für unsere Wunschzielgruppe: D2C E-Commerce Unternehmen.
jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du entwickelst einen Lead-Magnet für unsere Wunschzielgruppe: D2C E-Commerce Unternehmen. Kurz nach der Veröffentlichung zeigt sich das erste Ergebnis. Viele Eintragungen, und direkt vier neue Kundenanfragen.

Du wertest aus, was genau funktioniert hat, und leitest daraus neue Best-Performer-Ideen ab. Stimmst dich kurz mit Sebastian, dem Geschäftsführer, ab.

Du entwickelst daraus einen abgewandelten Guide für unseren YouTube-Kanal und schaust, dass zu dem Thema direkt passende LinkedIn-Beiträge geschrieben werden.

Parallel entstehen neue Ad-Konzepte für Meta Ads, die diesen Ansatz aufgreifen. Dazu kommt eine E-Mail-Kampagne, die den Inhalt auf einem anderen Kanal ausspielt.

Einige Tage später geht beides live. In wenigen Tagen sorgst du für Omnipräsenz auf allen Kanälen, sodass niemand an EVOLVE, als ganzheitlichem Wachstumspartner, vorbeikommt.

Zwei Wochen später hat unser Vertriebsteam den Kalender voll mit Terminen aus genau diesem Content. Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.

Wir denken B2B Marketing anders

Bei EVOLVE ist das ein eigenständiges System aus Ads, Content und Branding. Du verantwortest das System und führst es nicht nur aus. Darunter verstehen wir:

  • Pipeline-Generierung über Ads, Content und E-Mail als ein zusammenhängendes Marketingsystem, nicht als drei voneinander getrennte.

  • Aufbau der EVOLVE-Brand, um die Wahrnehmung als ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner in Deutschland zu stärken

  • KI-Workflows, die manuelle Abläufe ersetzen, damit die Zeit in Konzept statt in Klickarbeit fließt

Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst nicht ein paar Ads und einen Redaktionsplan für eine Agentur. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das gesamte Eigenmarketing von EVOLVE. Von der ersten Idee bis zur Anfrage im Vertrieb.

Genauso wie wir bei unseren Kunden durch Marketing messbares Wachstum erzeugen, machen wir das auch für uns selbst. Und dafür brauchen wir jemanden, der das verantwortet.

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du baust die Brand und das Agentur-Marketing von EVOLVE als System auf, statt einzelne Maßnahmen abzuarbeiten

  • Du entwickelst die Strategie hinter unseren Maßnahmen zur Pipeline-Generierung und priorisierst, was zuerst passiert

  • Du entwickelst eigene Content-Ideen und Content-Guides und schreibst LinkedIn-Posts direkt mit

  • Du entwickelst den Contentplan für YouTube, Podcast, E-Mail und LinkedIn und sorgst dafür, dass Content aus dem Team tatsächlich produziert wird

  • Du entwickelst Ad-Konzepte und gibst zu laufenden Ads Feedback, bevor Budget verbrannt wird

  • Du stimmst dich mit dem Media Buying ab, damit Kampagnen laufen, und verantwortest das Ergebnis, nicht die Klickarbeit

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Events und Messen wirklich neue Kunden bringen

  • Du steuerst alle Eigenmarketing-Projekte eigenverantwortlich, setzt Termine und hältst sie nach

  • Du wertest die Zahlen aus Ads, Content und E-Mail aus und lieferst der Geschäftsführung ungefragt den nächsten Schritt für qualifizierte Anfragen

Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE nur einmal. Wichtiger als Dokumentation ist die Zusammenarbeit über Fachbereichsgrenzen hinweg, mit Creative, Media Buying, Vertrieb und der Geschäftsführung gleichzeitig.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du hast schon einmal etwas von null aufgebaut, einen Kanal, einen Funnel, einen ganzen Bereich, und kannst mit Zahlen zeigen, was daraus geworden ist

  • Du hast ein Gespür für Direct Response: Du siehst einem Hook an, ob er zieht, noch bevor die erste Zahl reinkommt

  • Du denkst in ganzen Funnels, von der ersten Content-Idee bis zum qualifizierten Termin. Dabei siehst du, wie unser gesamtes Content-System zusammenspielt

  • 2 bis 3 Jahre Online-Marketing-Erfahrung mit eigener Ergebnisverantwortung

  • Du arbeitest mit Claude, Gemini oder vergleichbaren Modellen, und zwar mit eigenen Prompts und Abläufen, die du wiederverwendest. Nicht „nutze ich zur Recherche“, sondern ein echtes Werkzeug in deinem Alltag

  • Du hältst mehrere Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft, ohne dass einer runterfällt. Genau das erwartet dich hier, mit Ads, Content und E-Mail parallel

  • Du bringst ein Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen mit: Du weißt, wie man Kunden über Marketing langfristig überzeugt und bindet

  • Idealerweise hast du schon einmal eine Media- oder Personal-Brand aufgebaut, einen YouTube-Kanal, Podcast oder Newsletter mit echter Reichweite dahinter

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn du bisher vor allem nach Briefing gearbeitet hast und nie selbst entschieden hast, was gemacht wird. Wir haben zwar schon viele Erfahrungswerte, trotzdem bekommst du in dieser Rolle viel Gestaltungsspielraum, und genau der ist entscheidend für gute Ergebnisse. Und nicht, wenn du KI bisher nur zur Recherche nutzt oder dich gerade einarbeitest.

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, zusammen mit der Geschäftsführung.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Einarbeitung in laufende Kampagnen, Contentplan und Systeme. Du entwickelst bereits erste Ideen, Content Pieces und Ads, die wir wenig später antesten.

Mittelfristig. Vollständig eigenständige Verantwortung für Pipeline-Generierung und Brand-Aufbau.

Langfristig. Du verantwortest das gesamte Eigenmarketing von EVOLVE, nicht nur die Unternehmens- und Arbeitgebermarke EVOLVE, sondern auch einzelne Personal-Brands von Mitarbeitenden aus dem Team. Du bringst die gesamte Außenwahrnehmung auf ein komplett neues Level.
